MilkBoy in Philadelphia is one of those rare spots that perfectly blends great food, strong drinks, and authentic city energy. Located right on Chestnut Street, it’s both a café by day and a lively bar and music venue by night, drawing a diverse crowd of locals, students, and visitors. The atmosphere is relaxed yet buzzing, with a hint of grit that feels very “Philly.” The staff is friendly and down-to-earth, giving the place an unpretentious charm.

The menu covers all the essentials with a creative twist—everything from hearty breakfast sandwiches to burgers and bar snacks. Their breakfast burrito and grilled cheese are local favorites, and the coffee is surprisingly solid for a place that also serves whiskey and craft beer. The live music adds to the appeal, with small acts and local bands often performing upstairs, making it a go-to spot for discovering new talent.

Excellent service, very friendly staff. The place has a vibe all its own that's equal parts local bar and paradoy if commercial spots like hard rock cafe. Every show is intimate.

We’re all underground nerds and to make us feel so unwelcome in a space that’s supposed to be a place where we can finally feel welcome and like we “fit in” is just ridiculous. It’s disgusting. I saw U.S. girls here. I came all the way from VA. Super impressed with this place - it’s beautiful, it sounds great, the staff are incredibly sweet. I love to see a smaller venue that values production like this and I’ll definitely be back! It was well worth the trip!

Saw David Wax Museum here tonight and we were thrilled at how intimate of a setting it was.

Two floors from which to enjoy the bands, and all the views are enjoyable.

Philadelphia seems to be replete with fun, decent people.  At least it was here.  :)

We'll be back.
customer_insights: Johnny Brenda's is a lively bar and concert venue known for its friendly atmosphere and good food. While it offers a great spot for pre-gaming and casual hangouts, some patrons have noted issues with staff treatment during events, which could affect the overall experience.

googleReviews: Very delicious food with interesting combination of flavors that we don’t get. The service was very good. Waiter manager and others were making sure our drinks were filled and our table was cleaned up after every plate was changed out. We ordered the pork chop which didn’t come with any side really so you had to order one. The  steak with frits cane with the French fries which were suppose to be crispy but weren’t. cucumbers Thai side salad with a little spiciness and for dessert the Meyer’s lemon soufflé cake. I thought it would be warm but it wasn’t and it didn’t taste like a soufflé to me or my husband.

Had an awesome dinner here Saturday night with my wife. Service was amazing, our server was super attentive and kind. The food was excellent.
It was a little loud and crowded, but that’s what you come to expect for a Saturday night.
I’d love to go back and try more food!

Expectations were high when my beautiful wife and I had the chance to enjoy a lovely dinner out on a Friday night, and Talula's Garden lived up to and exceeded the hype. We checked online for a reservation the night before, but only super late options were available, so we decided to try dropping in. Walking in the city earlier in the evening, we popped in shortly before 4 pm (when they opened) and checked in with the host station. They were wonderfully helpful and arranged a 5:30 pm reservation for two. Nestled in the corner of Washington Square Park, the restaurant is beautiful and romantic. We had drinks and started with the cheddar biscuits, which couldn't have been better. We were tempted by the meatball appetizer, but didn't want to be too stuffed, so that will have to be next time! The steak frites were amazing - perfectly prepared and so delicious. My wife loved her autumn salmon - really nice! The peanut butter chocolate cake dessert was a triumph. We are already planning our return trip - one of the best dinners we've had in a long time. Thank you so much!

I’ve been to Talula’s Garden twice now, and both visits have been consistently excellent. The service is top-notch. The servers have been friendly and attentive. The food is just as impressive, with fresh, high-quality ingredients!

Most recently, I went for brunch with some of my best friends and I had the buttermilk fried chicken and waffle. It came with sautéed peaches and a light honey drizzle, and it was absolutely delicious. It was the perfect balance of sweet and savory.

I can definitely say that Talula’s Garden is becoming one of my favorite spots in Philly for both the food and the experience.

I came here with my fiancee on a spur of the moment dinner while we were in the city. I found it easy to get a table, which is awesome for such a great place.

Overall the food was great, I don't exactly recall what we ate, but the salad with goat cheese was an excellent starter, and we left with a smile on our face.

Service was good, and we liked the cute atmosphere. The manager was extremely nice and seemed to be happy to be there.

We will be back for sure!
customer_insights: Talula's Garden is known for its upscale dining experience with a romantic atmosphere, making it ideal for special occasions like first dates and anniversaries. The restaurant offers a menu featuring fresh, seasonal ingredients and has received consistent praise for its attentive service and delicious food.

I stopped by Philadelphia over the weekend and decided to visit this place after seeing how busy it was both in the morning and at night — and the great reviews didn’t lie! The restaurant sits right across from a park, and despite the crowd and size, the staff were incredibly kind and attentive (except for the host — a little smile or warmth would’ve made a much better first impression).

Thanks to the generous, delicious breakfast and the genuinely kind service, my day started off perfectly. The gentleman who guided us to our table greeted us with such thoughtful manners, and our server’s hospitality was truly flawless. It’s been a while since I had such a pleasant dining experience, so I happily left a bigger tip than usual.

These days, some restaurants can’t even provide decent basic service yet still circle the “extra tip” section on the receipt — but this place was outstanding in every way.

The bread basket was amazing — even the complimentary bread was fresh and delicious. The butter was a bit too cold and hard to spread, but the jam that came with it was wonderful. The onion soup we shared was absolutely perfect, and the beet salad was fresh, tangy, and refreshing. The quiche was soft, seasoned well, and had an ideal texture.

The only small downside was the coffee, which could have been better. But overall, the bright smile and warm service from our server, along with the team’s attentiveness even during the busy rush, made this a truly delightful breakfast experience.

Highly recommend — this place absolutely deserves its great reputation!

My wife and I visited Parc on Thanksgiving, the atmosphere was great and restaurant was beautifully decorated. The service was great, my wife ordered the Beef Bourguignon and it was fantastic. She also ordered the Onion Soup, but was disappointed because although it tasted great it did not have broth. I order the Steak Frits  it had a good taste but a bit to fatty not a good cut. The experience was great, but certain item's could have been for price. Nevertheless greatful to have a place to spend Thanksgiving with my wife. Thanks for being open and providing a service when you could be home with your family members. Happy Thanksgiving

Amazing restaurant. All the food was incredible. I had always wanted to try a croque monsieur, and it did not disappoint.

Bread and appetizers were high quality and delicious. The cranberry nut bread was my favorite. Very moist and flavorful.

My wife is a connoisseur of fine French Onion soup, and she exclaimed that this was the best she'd ever had.

The quiche Lorraine was delightful, fluffy and crusty, very light. Portion size is perfect - you won't leave hungry but you won't need a cart to haul leftovers. Its just right.

Desserts are to die for. This is the best creme brulee I've ever had, and the chocolate mousse is the perfect flavor, sweetness and a magical consistency you cant make at home.

Service was perfect at well. Our server Samantha is delightful, quick with a knowledgeable recommendation and great conversation. The manager Sawyer visited our table and was clearly invested in the quality of food and performance of his staff.

10/10 highest recommendation. Will be back soon!

We had an amazing experience at Parc! From the moment we arrived, everything ran smoothly — even with the heavy crowd, we were seated surprisingly quickly. The atmosphere was lively, and the dishes were quite unique and memorable.

A special shout-out to our server, Oleksandr, who was absolutely outstanding. He was incredibly friendly, perfectly matched our mood, and truly became the highlight of our evening. His energy and attitude added that special touch that made our night unforgettable.

Everything was wonderful, and we’ll definitely be coming back! Highly recommended.

Саня ты крутой 👌🏻😎

We wanted to try lunch. We ordered cheese omlette and mozarella sandwich. As dessert of course crème brule. The bread basket was really yummy. Very crowded we waited some time to get seated. googleReviews: I love this little Italian restaurant so much! My husband and I came for a first night in Philadelphia dinner and it did not disappoint. We loved the dim lighting with candle lit tables and the food was fantastic. Everything we ordered was incredible. Everything tasted so fresh and flavorful and you could tell the ingredients were super high quality. We will definitely recommend this restaurant to anybody who wants delicious food with great service.

My husband and I threw a 40 person dinner party in their back court yard on 11/1 to celebrate our elopement in Italy with friends and family. Little Nonna’s did Ana amazing job from start to finish. They had the most helpful staff, the best bar tenders, and the best food that everyone loved. We felt like everything was perfectly taken care of and no matter what we asked of them, they always saw it through. I can’t thank the staff enough  and Maggie the event coordinator who was there to answer my questions every step of the way. We had a blast and want to do it all over again. They did amazing!!!

I got the arancini and chicken parm here and they were both delicious. Generous portion sizes, the pasta with the chicken parm was enough for 2. I do like my espresso martinis a little creamier but the other drinks on the menu looked good. Service was fast as well!

I travel for work, on the road sometimes weeks at a time. When I say that this was the best spaghetti and meatballs I’ve ever had I mean it. Several states, cities, and countless Italian spots. Little nonnas takes the cake. On top of that the garlic bread and tiramisu are heavenly. Whether you are a Philly native or just traveling in for a visit. I beg that you give this a try, you will not regret it. Unfortunately the photos will not do it justice.

Absolutely amazing experience from the moment we walked in. We were sat in the courthouse which I didn’t even know they had and it was perfect. One of the best espresso martinis I’ve had in a while and the food was excellent. We got the garlic bread with the head of garlic, so good. The eggplant parm was delightful and the arancini was very good as well but could’ve used some salt. For main entrees we got rigatoni aka vodka and the short rib pasta which were perfect. The service was also great! Will definitely be returning!
customer_insights: Little Nonna's is a beloved Italian restaurant in Philadelphia known for its upscale ambiance and high-quality ingredients. Diners rave about the flavorful dishes, attentive service, and romantic setting, making it an ideal spot for special occasions and intimate dinners.

Had the best experience at Butcher and Singer, out for my husband’s birthday. The rolls were melt in your mouth delicious, I had the Chilean Sea Bass which was cooked to perfection! My Crab Cake was also extremely tasty, lump crab savored in every bite. Exceptional service and a birthday plate to finish off our evening. Priced for very special occasions for sure.

Everything about this place was a pleasant experience. The food was amazing, the rib eye I ordered was perfect to say the least and the sides was an added delight. The star of the show was them biscuits they where the best ever. Our waiter was very polite and courteous and the ambiance was a real vibe. I will definitely return if im ever back in Philly.

My wife and I were in Philly this past week for a concert, and I wanted to take her some place ritzy and fancy to celebrate our anniversary. Grandma’s Philly has been on my list to try forever, and I’m so glad I finally got around to visiting! It’s a great place to get Thai cuisine in an upscale but still relaxed environment.

We sat at the bar and started with a thai espresso martini. It was rich and creamy, but a tad sweet for my liking.

For food, we got the grandma’s meatballs, crispy chives and drunken noodles. The grandma’s meatballs were outstanding - the sauce was very robust (sweet + savory). I used the sauce in conjunction with the other dishes. The crispy chives were fried perfectly and had a lot more flavor than I was expecting. The drunken noodles we got with chicken and spice level 2. The heat was a nice kick without being overpowering, and I enjoyed the wide noodles.

The menu was so expansive, I had a hard time choosing (a good problem). This is now a new favorite restaurant, and I can’t wait to come back and try more.

First of all, shoutout to Jada for an excellent experience and great recommendations!

Curry puffs were out of this world. Crunchy exterior, soft pastry inside with a flavorful curry filling. Heaven

The Duck was fall off the bone tender was gone within a minute of hitting the table.

Drunken Noodles were very good with tons of flavor and good amount of protein. The noodles were killer, soft with a slight chew.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Grandma’s Philly Restaurant is an absolute gem! The food tastes just like something straight from grandma’s kitchen — comforting, flavorful, and made with so much love. Every dish comes out fresh and full of flavor, but the real standouts for me are Grandma’s Meatballs and the Papaya Salad. The meatballs are tender, juicy, and packed with rich, savory flavor — easily one of my favorites. The papaya salad is super refreshing with the perfect balance of tangy, spicy, and crunchy — it complements everything so well!

The staff are always warm and friendly, making you feel like part of the family. The space has a cozy, welcoming vibe, and the portions are generous for the price.

If you’re craving a hearty, home-style meal that hits the spot every time, Grandma’s Philly is the place to go. I’m already looking forward to coming back for more meatballs and papaya salad!

Good food, good service, good environment. I eat Thai often and Grandma's did not disappoint. We went late and only had light bites, but they were very tasty. Typically I try green curry when I go to a new Thai place, but the veggie spring rolls and shrimp skewers were exactly what my taste buds expected. The service was quick and had good suggestions. It's definitely worth a visit if you're in the area and want Thai.

The food here was a mixed bag:

Papaya salad - decent flavor but had no heat and could have used a bit more acidity and salt
Veggie spring rolls - very good. Nice crisp, great filling
Curry chicken puffs - a bit doughy, but the filling was generous and delicious
Salmon in a basket - surprise breakout dish of the evening. Absolutely delicious with a balanced amount of heat
Crab flutes - good crisp but generally nothing remarkable or special. The salted shrimp mixed in was a nice touch

Chu chee salmon - disappointing. The salmon was overcooked and the sauce was confused. It tasted of salted shrimp, fish sauce and just far too much palm sugar or whatever sweetener was being used
Khao soi - delicious, thick broth with a generous helping of varying noodles that kept it texturally interesting. The white rice paired with this was overly dry.
Crab fried rice - relatively generous portion of rice but the actual fried rice was average
customer_insights: Grandma's Philly offers a cozy and welcoming atmosphere with a focus on comforting Thai dishes. Diners rave about the flavorful Grandma's Meatballs and Drunken Noodles, making it a great spot for casual outings or special occasions.

googleReviews: We went to Bud & Marilyn’s for brunch after seeing all the great reviews. We were seated quickly and arrived just a minute before brunch ended, but they still accommodated us, which was nice. The food, however, wasn’t the best. The standout item — and a must-try — is the cinnamon roll. It’s huge, soft, and perfectly sweet, definitely worth sharing. Unfortunately, the fried chicken was overly salty and dry, so we didn’t finish it. They recommended the pancakes, which was not good at all. It was bland and has a weird flavor, not what you expected from seeing how beautiful it was.The atmosphere was cute and cozy, but overall, I wasn’t too impressed with the food. I’d go back again, but only for those amazing cinnamon rolls!

My wife and I came to Bud and Marilyn’s on a Saturday morning for brunch. We were in the city for a matinee show and made a reservation a week in advance. We were seated right away. The front of house staff was very friendly and engaging. We were given ample time to decide and order without feeling ignored. The cinnamon roll arrived about 5 minutes after ordering it and it was delicious! Definitely worth sharing. I ordered the sausage and biscuits and my wife ordered the Croque Madame which was a daily special. Both were fantastic. The biscuits were not dry and the gravy had a great flavor without being overly salty. The bread on the Croque Madame had a little sweetness to it with great balance to the ham and cheese. Overall, everything was great and would highly recommend!

Dropped in for brunch and appreciated the relaxed vibe. It wasn’t crowded when we arrived, so we were seated quickly—always a win.

The highlight? Hands down the cinnamon roll. Soft, moist, packed with flavor, and surprisingly good even with raisins (which I usually avoid). It’s absolutely worth a return visit on its own.

As for the meal: I had the chicken and waffle. The chicken was tender, but lacked seasoning—it needed a boost from salt, pepper, and hot sauce to really come alive. The waffle had a solid soft crunch— nice balance, and the fried egg was perfectly cooked.

Drinks were good, but since I ordered a French 75, hard to say much—it’s not a cocktail that’s easy to mess up.

Would I go back? Maybe, if I’m nearby. I’d try something different next time, but I’d definitely order the cinnamon roll again.

I’m currently sitting at the table as I write this review, the breakfast for my wife and I was so incredibly amazing, I felt compelled to write this as I finish my Bloody Mary. I had the sausage and biscuits, my wife had the tiramisu French toast. You can’t go wrong with either choice.  I would imagine any choice on the
Menu will satisfy your hunger.

We will be back again.  Alyssa, you were a great server, perfect amount of attention to our needs while not being overly tentative.

This was a great find. The food, service, and atmosphere was great. Great music playing in the background. We enjoyed this visit. We had a great time talking and eating. I would highly recommend this place to anyone that visits the downtown Philadelphia area. It was an 8 minute walk from our hotel, so we got to get some walking time in on the way.
customer_insights: Bud & Marilyn's is a cozy brunch spot in Philadelphia known for its standout cinnamon rolls, which consistently receive rave reviews. While some dishes may lack seasoning, the friendly service and relaxed atmosphere make it a suitable choice for casual dining, first dates, and group outings.

googleReviews: The food was phenomenal, the service was great, the music was unexpectedly great what more can you ask for ?  I especially enjoyed the laffa bread portion of the meal with all of the dipping arrangements, as far as dessert goes I eat dairy free so the sorbet was very delicious. I do wish my reservation was earlier in the day, because I missed out on the duck as there is a limited supply. Worth the trip 🤝🏾👍🏾

We had the tasting menu at Zahav and it was absolutely amazing from start to finish. The hummus was super fresh and easily one of the best I’ve ever had. The beet salad was incredible—bright, flavorful, and beautifully balanced. For the main course, the lamb shoulder was perfectly tender and rich, and we also received a complementary fluke dish that was a fantastic surprise. Dessert was a silky chocolate pudding that ended the meal on a perfect note.

We sat at the bar and had a great experience—the bartender was engaging, knowledgeable, and really added to the evening. Overall, everything about the meal and service was top-notch. We’ll definitely be back!

We had dinner at Zahav on 10/7 and it was one of the best meals we’ve ever had! It’s known for their tasting menu of Israeli cuisine. If you haven’t dined here before: The meal starts with their laffa flatbread and an assortment of dips and small dishes. For the second course, everyone at the table picks a few small plates to share. And for the third course, you can either go big with a shared entrée or each choose your own smaller dish. To finish, each person gets to select a dessert.

For our second course, we selected the roasted figs, fried cauliflower, and phyllo-wrapped haloumi. For our main course, we had their famous pomegranate lamb shoulder, braised for 72 hours.

Our server was very nice and professional and on top of everything. However, what really made our experience stand out was the manager, Steve.

When he found out my 11-year-old son is a self-proclaimed foodie, he surprised him with custom mocktail pairings for each course, a thoughtful, charming touch that completely made my son’s night!

We were on the fence about bringing our son to Zahav and Steve made us feel really welcome. My son keeps telling us it is the best restaurant experience in his life.

In short, I highly recommend Zahav. Make a reservation on the earlier side so you can stuff yourself and spend the rest of your evening digesting in bliss. Our only disappointment is that we couldn’t bring the leftovers home.

Zahav definitely did not disappoint and was well worth the 1+ month wait for a reservation. Exceptional cuisine with outstanding service! Suggest going with a group of 4 or more since portions are plentiful and the food literally seems to never stop coming. Menu is limited to price fixed only. Somewhat pricey but well worth the cost for this culinary experience!

Had a reservation for 530, and we were sat immediately. Waitress was very friendly, explained the menu and specials. All the hummus dips were spectacular and the highlight of the meals. Appetizers were unique and flavorful. Entrees had great spices and seasoning, but we felt the quality of the meats should be have been a notch higher. Desserts were good but unremarkable. We got the wine pairing option and one of our group is a sommelier, she was very pleased with the selections.
customer_insights: Zahav offers a unique and upscale dining experience centered around Israeli cuisine, featuring a tasting menu that encourages sharing. Guests rave about the exceptional food quality, attentive service, and the vibrant atmosphere, making it ideal for special occasions and memorable dinners.

We had a disappointing brunch experience here (10/11/2025).

First issue — the only bartender was also our server, and he was too busy with drink orders to give us attentive service. Aside from taking our order, he never checked in, and it was difficult to flag him down when we needed something. At one point, another server had to step in to help.

Second issue — my husband’s steak and eggs came out rare when he ordered medium. It’s unclear whether the bartender entered it incorrectly or the kitchen made a mistake, but since the steak was sliced and visibly rare, it never should’ve been served that way if the order was entered correctly.

Third issue — when the kitchen “fixed” it, they reheated the steak slices and brought them back on the same plate, where the scrambled eggs and potatoes were now lukewarm. For a restaurant of this caliber, the entire dish should’ve been remade. Reheating food that’s already been served and putting it back on the same plate is a food safety risk, which is especially disappointing for a restaurant that boasts of being a James Beard Foundation award winner.

Fourth issue — our bartender/server never mentioned the issue to the manager. He delivered the check without an apology or any acknowledgement of what went wrong. I ended up requesting to speak to a manager, and the manager was clearly surprised about everything that happened. To his credit, the manager apologized profusely and comped our entire meal, even though the only menu item I wanted comped was the steak and eggs.

I appreciate how the manager handled it and made things right, but I’m honestly surprised a restaurant with this reputation had so many basic service and food handling issues.

—-
Below is the response I originally got from Fork on 10/17. I’m not sure why management edited their response weeks later:

Response to my Fork review:

Hi Wen, Thank you for taking the time to share such a detailed review of your recent brunch experience on 10/11. We sincerely apologize for the disappointing visit and want you to know that your concerns are being taken very seriously. First and foremost, we regret that your service fell short due to our bartender being stretched too thin. While we aim to provide attentive, seamless service no matter the staffing situation, we clearly missed the mark here, and that’s not the standard we hold ourselves to. We’re also very sorry about the mishandled steak order and how it was addressed. You're absolutely right that a steak ordered medium should never be served rare, and reheating a plated dish, rather than remaking it fresh, is unacceptable—both from a quality and food safety standpoint. Your feedback has prompted a thorough review of our kitchen and service protocols to ensure this doesn't happen again. Regarding the lack of communication between your server and our management team—we completely agree that your concerns should have been acknowledged and escalated sooner. We're glad to hear our manager was able to step in and take corrective action, but that should have happened proactively, not after your request. We deeply appreciate your recognition of how the manager handled the situation, and we're equally grateful that you gave us the opportunity to address the issue while you were still here. Please know we are taking this feedback to heart and making internal adjustments to prevent similar experiences in the future. If you're open to giving us another chance, we’d love the opportunity to provide the kind of experience you rightfully expected.

First time here. The drinks were good, amaretto sour with a froth, and a espresso martini. The waitress stated that the salad appetizer was enough for the whole table of four. It wasn't even enough for 2. I had the mussels, they were a bit fishy tasting for everyone. I also had the Atlantic cod, which was seasoned just right. The crab dish in a shell was tasty, it had little yellow edible flowers in it. My friends loved the pork chop dish, and the pasta. Desserts were good, I had the pretzel crusted cannoli with chocolate mouse, friends had the goat milk ice cream with a berry sauce. They were all fresh and light. I would return for dessert and drinks. It's a little pricey for the portions, but that's what you get when you have awards
customer_insights: Fork in Philadelphia is known for its upscale dining experience, highlighted by attentive service and a focus on quality ingredients. While many patrons rave about the food and ambiance, there have been occasional service hiccups, particularly during busy times. Overall, it's a great choice for special occasions and romantic dinners.

googleReviews: Darling Jacks Tavern is a cute romantic spot for dates. A lot of dishes are meant to be shared. We got steak tartare with chips, which was really good and fresh, not gamey at all. Would’ve hoped for it to be slightly saltier, 4/5. The beet salad was interesting to say the least. It is mixed with pear, nuts, fennel, radish and cheese which all complemented each other, what a wonderful combination, 5/5. Lastly, of course we gotta have French onion soup. I’d recommend each person ordering one for themselves because it is very small. Otherwise, it was flavorful with different kinds of onions (raw, caramelized), imparting different textures, 4/5. With the environment and service, overall rating for me is 4.5/5. Would absolutely go back again!

Bustling busy place, loud but not too loud to talk some. Not a place for conversation though. Their specialty bun was way yummier than expected; recommended. Service was great. Their pepperoni and oregano pizza was really tasty. The menu is small which is a good thing here because they seem to do each dish really well. We sat by the kitchen and we're impressed with the professionalism and how great every plate looked they sent out!

Darling Jack's Tavern nails it as a charming happy hour spot with some great snacks and amazing atmosphere. While I recommend visiting for a spot at the bar, I unfortunately can't further recommend it for a full dinner.

We had a reservation for two for dinner, and luckily for us they had small two-person booths available in the bar area which meant we could still get happy hour deals (happy hour isn't available in the non-bar areas). We did their tavern wedge salad which was a quite heavy wedge of lettuce loaded with bacon, cheese, avocado, and ranch. I enjoyed it just fine and my wife liked it quite a bit. My favorite thing, and definitely the main attraction if I were to return, was their tavern style pizza. For a reasonable price it was a flavorful, crispy, perfectly shareable and simple pizza. While I really appreciated it, I will note that my wife wasn't as enthusiastic and just thought it was okay.

The big disappointment was the braised short rib cannelloni. Despite how good it looks in the picture, we were surprised that it was mediocre to borderline bad. The pasta was dry, the beef was completely flavorless, and for the size of both elements it didn't make any sense to put them together in the dish when they made each other worse. The sauce was the only saving grace but it wasn't enough. Do not get this dish despite how tempting it sounds.

Overall I enjoyed our experience well enough, and can understand someone having a great time if they focused solely on the bar and happy hour snack side of things. But other aspects might be disappointing.

Stumbled upon this place and so glad we did! A 5 Star unexpected lunch with incredible staff , flavor , and vibe
We ordered two different bowls for lunch (one chicken and one salmon ) and some kind of cinnamon milk bun for a sweet and fabulous finish. The espresso martini was also incredible and unique
Can’t wait to go back!

Delicious!  Darling Jacks onion soup is amazing! Their butternut squash and arugula pizza with garlic cream sauce was the perfect blend of flavors. It looked so good when it arrived at the table that we ate half of before I remembered to take a picture! We will definitely be back. :)
customer_insights: Darling Jack's Tavern is a charming spot ideal for dates and casual gatherings, offering a lively atmosphere with a focus on shareable dishes. While the happy hour is a highlight, some menu items can be hit or miss, making it best suited for those looking to enjoy drinks and snacks rather than a full dinner.

googleReviews:
Traveled to Philly for the Eagles vs Bears game to discover this Italian Gem. Turns out we were really lucky to get last minute reservations as they are always booked. They are known to be the BEST Italian Restaurant in Philly.  Did it meet the expectations…absolutely.  The food was delicious and loved the small sourdough bread.
The appetizers were so good. Most importantly our server Ty was the bomb !! He remembered all the orders and he was witty.

I took my boyfriend here for this birthday & let me just say it was phenomenal! From the atmosphere, to the food, to the service.. this place really outdid themselves. The byob was really nice to have. The host Carly was great! She was very welcoming & our server Ty was also great! Attentive & very sweet. We had the margarita pizza & spinach dip as apps, 10/10! I enjoyed my meal, it was meatballs with ravioli & my boyfriend had chicken parm. My boyfriend didn’t really enjoy the chicken that came with the chicken parm but honestly it’s just preference. Other than that our meals were good! For deserts we had the tiramisu & chocolate mousse, these were also great. We will definitely be back again! Thank you ty & Carly!

I had seen reviews, and was glad to say they were spot on. The service was great-very attentive waiter, even though he was running the whole floor (it was lunch time). Loved the ambiance. Music wasn't too loud, seating was cozy but not where people are on top of you. Started off with some warm, crusty bread with oil and balsamic. Then tried the Margarita pizza appetizer (outstanding flavor and crust). For the main dish, had the chicken parmesan roast with penne on the side. The chicken was crispy on the outside, but still moist. The sauce just made it the perfect dish. Prices were great for the portions that were served. This will be on my return list for sure.

BYOB! Food was great and was served quickly. Pizza is super cheesy. Caesar salad was amazing, and they did not skimp out on the dressing. The desserts are homemade, and were delicious. Ty, our server, was super friendly and provided great service. The restaurant is a super cute place!

Such a great experience - food was phenomenal! Staff was even better - Sam was so friendly and helpful in navigating the BYOB & getting us a table! Adil made it such a friendly and warm experience - we felt so welcomed. Vodka sauce was 🔥🔥!! Chicken parmigiana was bigger than my head. Can’t recommend it enough.
customer_insights: Osteria Ama Philly is a highly-rated Italian restaurant known for its delicious food and attentive service. The atmosphere is cozy and upscale, making it ideal for romantic dinners, special occasions, or a casual night out with friends. The BYOB policy adds a unique touch, allowing guests to personalize their dining experience.

googleReviews:
We visited Cuba Libre after a Lyft driver recommended it to us — and wow, what an amazing suggestion. The décor is absolutely beautiful, full of character and tropical charm. We went during a quieter time and sat at the upstairs bar, which made the experience even better.

Our bartender was incredibly friendly and attentive. The cocktails were outstanding — we love trying new drinks, and this place did not disappoint. I ordered the coconut mojito first, and it was delicious. She then recommended another cocktail with a fruity touch, and that one was just as good. My husband tried an Old Fashioned and a classic mojito, both of which he loved.

Even when they were having a small issue with the heating, our bartender apologized so kindly and made sure we were comfortable the entire time. Her service was truly excellent.

We had just eaten elsewhere, so we only tried the cocktails this time, but everything was so good that we can’t wait to come back specifically to try the food.

Highly recommended — 100%. We’ll definitely be returning.

The environment and restaurant looked amazing with such an incredible vibe. The flavors of everything from the appetizers were incredible. I was very disappointed with the portion of my brisket dish. It looked half eaten, took about 3 bites to finish. For almost $35 it left a lot to be desired and there was barely much meat there, mostly onions and garlic with a hint of meat every now and then. Other than that this place was great
We celebrated my friends bridal shower here and it was a great experience. The food and drinks were delicious. The staff was so accommodating and nice! Can’t wait to come back.

Fun place, decent prices for old city, fantastic service. The atmosphere was great, and the staff was fantastic. The food was decent, fresh/hot/tasty but took a backseat to the ambience. Veggies were a bit undercooked for my liking, but that’s a personal preference. Flavors were good and the veggies and meat seemed high quality. Definitely a pleasant dining experience, especially if Cuban food is your thing.

Fantastic place to visit in Philadelphia.
Design,  drinks and food are excellent.
You should try thee chef's tasting menu  $49(includes bread, 3startes,4 main tasting plates,dessert) paired with drinks ($20, mohito, glass of wine and rum as compliment ).
Total check for 2 with taxes and 25% tips $186.
customer_insights: Cuba Libre Restaurant & Rum Bar offers a vibrant atmosphere with a tropical charm, making it a popular choice for both casual dining and nightlife. Guests rave about the cocktails and attentive service, although some have noted inconsistencies in food portion sizes. Overall, it's a great spot for celebrations, date nights, or a fun evening out with friends.

googleReviews:
Show at Academy of Music ended earlier than we expected on Sunday afternoon, but plenty of room to take us almost an hour earlier than our reservation. It was very quiet on a Sunday afternoon.

Very nice atmosphere with a great waiter (Cory). Food was more than amazing. Charred octopus and grilled sardines were great. The halibut was so moist. Desserts were phenomenal.

Great place for a business meal! The pricing was very fair and the food was delicious! The portion of the rice with the salmon was a bit small, but conversely the salmon slab was massive and the capers were cooked to perfection. The downstairs business area has very limited WiFi & cell service, so make sure to download anything you need prior to going down. Service was very fast and very personable!

We came on a Saturday after a show- no reservation, it was late so we sat at the bar for dinner with drinks. The bartenders were great, professional, friendly. The food was amazing! Not cheap, but worth it for a treat or special occasion. We’ll definitely return!

I have never in my life taken the time to write anything less than a 5-star review. The food and ambiance here was absolutely amazing. However, I have never had such a negative service experience in my life. The server seemed to be in a rush and would come over every 5 minutes pressuring my friend and I to order even though we repeatedly asked for more time. She seemed to be very unhappy about this and made a snide remark about us taking our time. After that, she had a very passive aggressive attitude for the rest of our dinner. I would love to come back because the food was truly great; however, the service I experienced is a major deterrent and really left a bad taste in my mouth.

Came here yesterday with my sister for both of our first times before heading to see the symphony. I’m so glad we came. We did not have a reservation but thankfully we’re still seated right away. Our server was a very nice older gentleman who explained the menu and gave us a very nice dining experience with no pressure to hurry and eat, so the vibe was very relaxing. The restaurant is beautiful and right near the theatre. Food and drink was fantastic. They were very accommodating of my sisters dairy intolerance and made great recommendations. The chicken was roasted perfectly with a crispy crust and she reported her lamb chops were fantastic. Highly recommend!
customer_insights: Estia Restaurant offers a refined Mediterranean dining experience with a focus on seafood and an upscale ambiance, making it ideal for special occasions or romantic dinners. While the food receives high praise, service experiences can vary, so guests should be prepared for potential inconsistencies.

googleReviews: Loved the ambience as soon as we stepped in. Didn’t make reservations but was able to find a seat at the bar with no issue. This is a repurposed bank. Vibes were nice. Service was very friendly, food was good. Husband enjoyed his ribeye, and I loved the burrata salad. Good wine list and drink selection. Would return

Ben should get 10 stars for his service. He greeted our table right away and was attentive throughout the entire meal. Ben not only knew alot about the menu and wine, he also pointed out interesting things about the building and history of the building. Our meal was wonderful. I gave it 4/5 because my steak was over-cooked on the surf & turf. It still tasted good and the trio was over the top good. Lovely atmosphere! Thank you for making my birthday a special occasion! I would definitely ask for Ben when booking your table reservation!

Met the GM when we walked in letting her know we were celebrating our anniversary as well as one of the floor managers. They took good care of us with server team pictured. Shrimp cocktail perfect as expected in a fine steakhouse. Crab meat cocktail was tasty. Caesar salad superb. The porterhouse was cooked as ordered, wonderfully tender and well seasoned. Disappointed only lobster tails available were baby in size despite being on menu. Au gratin potatoes were cheesy good but more mashed than whole. Asparagus was great. Old fashioneds were solid. Restaurant is huge in size, three stories, looks like old bank building. The yacht rock music playing loudly was off putting as my video clip shows. Pay a jazz band to play live for a better vibe that fits the location.

Early reservation on a Saturday. Jessica our server was excellent! Asked questions regarding dietary restrictions and helped us navigate the menu. The London Maid was a pretty good cocktail; light and refreshing. Blood Orange Spritz was also enjoyable. Bacon appetizer was delicious and peppery! Wedge salad was good but seemed a bit small. Chicken entree was really delicious but thought it was better without the sauce that was provided on the side. Salmon was excellent! Chateau potatoes were a bit too peppery for us but the flavor was good. Don't get me wrong, I like pepper but this was pretty peppery. Orange Creme brulee was incredibly unusual but was quite delicious! We were impressed! It should be noted that the gluten sensitive menu wasn't accurate because we were told the berries and creme wasn't gluten free even though it was on the gluten sensitive menu; the creme brulee was gluten free (without the cookie on top) but it wasn't listed as an option. Strange. Finally, the worst part of the experience: it was cold in the restaurant, so I put on a light jacket that happened to have a hood on it. I was leaving the restaurant and I was accosted by the security guy who told me hoodies were not allowed in the restaurant. Was totally not necessary to engage with me on that because I was literally leaving! To me , a "hoodie" is an athletic wear sweatshirt and this was a light jacket that happened to have a hood on it. If you don't want any hooded attire in the establishment, that's fine (good luck in the winter!) but I think you should clarify that in your dress code to specify no hooded clothing period. Thanks!

Everything is fine, food was good little bit above average, but mostly average, I am basing my review on the experience of other restaurants at the same tier. The quality control of the food was lacking the shrimp from the seafood tower was very well done!, It's been in the fridge and it's old, Look, I'm not a cook I just know how to eat. The shrimp was hard and had a chewy texture. So now for dinner, I wasn't craving meat so I ordered a dozen oysters as my dinner since it was delicious from the seafood tower. I had a terrible experience, where I asked to speak to someone in charge. I ate some shared lobster macaroni cheese and a lobster shell actually cut my tongue the gentleman said he would remove it from the bill, which didn't happen Second bad experience, which I was lucky I caught it before I could have gotten injured or hurt. There was a big shell on top of the oyster side you eat from, again the gentleman asked if we could take this oyster with the shell back to the kitchen to inspect, and they would give us 2 oysters back for the inconvenience, they brought out two of the smallest oysters that were dry and looked nasty! The restaurant is very pricey, for them to be so cheap and petty when there's an inconvenience to their customer. This is my third time at this place, and my review result is still the same, this place is on the pricer side for the overall experience.
customer_insights: Del Frisco's Double Eagle Steakhouse offers an upscale dining experience with a focus on high-quality steaks and seafood. The venue is noted for its beautiful ambiance, friendly service, and a rich history as a repurposed bank. While the food quality is generally praised, some reviews indicate inconsistency in preparation and service, particularly regarding dietary accommodations.

googleReviews:
We had a great night at Barclay Prime.

From the moment we walked in, the vibe was incredible, and the service was top-notch.

We kicked things off with some drinks: I had the Metropolitano, which was awesome, and my friends tried the BP Old Fashioned and a dirty martini. We started with a shrimp cocktail that was out of this world, and they also loved the oysters. For the main course, I went with the 12 oz. American Wagyu New York Strip, cooked to perfection. And we topped it all off with the banana pudding crème brûlée for dessert—absolutely delicious!

Everything about the experience, from the atmosphere to the food, was spot on.

Amazing food! I had the Waygu and rare aged blue cheese. Should have had the meat alone to really enjoy the steak unaltered. Old fashioned was also very tasty. Expensive but very good. They let you pick from a set of knives and explain the strengths of each. The scallops were the best I've had.

We celebrated our anniversary this weekend, and BP did not disappoint. The service was amazing(thanks Janelle), the food was delicious, and the atmosphere was vibey. We had the scallops(lights out), chopped salad, ribeye, halibut, truffle mac, onion strings and green beans. My absolute favorite parts were the scallops, dinner rolls(OMG) and how fresh the green beans were. I could eat those green beans all day! Really nicely done!

Came to celebrate my birthday, Beautiful space with a classy ambiance, the service was immaculate, our server said he'd been there 20 years and I could tell.
The bread? So so good. Hamachi Crudo was a bit lifeless and the ponzu? Sauce was a bit thick for me.
The wagyu sliders were juicy and delicious. The chicken entree was soooo unique in flavor I really enjoyed it, but unfortunately I was super disappointed in my filet, especially for a steakhouse. The char was nice but overall way too salty, and I asked for medium, it was borderline rare, I couldn't even finish it. But the server brought a yummy birthday pastry and that kinda made up for it. Drinks were a bit watery but we got a Mule which wasn't on the menu so maybe just not something they make a lot.

Food was great, the dining area was a little loud so I asked to be seated in the lobby which was still nice, just a little quieter. Our server was Richie and he was great he had great energy and the service was great, he was very attentive and made our time at Barclay prime more enjoyable.
customer_insights: Barclay Prime offers an upscale dining experience with a focus on high-quality steaks and seafood. The ambiance is perfect for romantic dinners and special occasions, with attentive service and a trendy atmosphere that appeals to both couples and groups celebrating milestones.

googleReviews:
One of the best meals I've ever had, and definitely a top three in Philly. Exceptional food, outstanding service, immaculate vibes. They have the best kind of tasting menu, where each person gets to choose from 3-5 options per course. This made for a very fun meal with 3 other people where we all got different things and tried bites from each one. They also sent out several surprise bites, and the welcome cocktail was such a nice way to start. What a fun night with the best food! Such great textures, flavors, colors -- it was all happening!

(We came for the first time in July 2025, but just getting to my review now).

We had an incredible birthday dinner for my husband at Vetri. The food was exceptional—creative, beautiful, and above all, delicious. The wines selected paired beautifully with each course and the sommelier was both extremely knowledgeable and very approachable. Overall, one of the best meals we have had in Philly!

Vetri Cucina is where culinary magic happens... each visit over the past two years has been nothing short of unforgettable. The seasonal tasting menu? Always a showstopper. The pasta? Quite possibly life-changing. The raspberry caramels? I asked for extras once and they delivered (literally and figuratively).

Service is top-tier, thoughtful, accommodating, and excellent. They’ve handled food allergies, surprise celebrations, and even my accidental month-early reservation with total grace. The space is intimate and elegant, near Center City with cozy lighting and two floors of charm. Even a baby made an appearance on one visit, and the whole dining room welcomed the little guest with smiles. Rare and lovely.

Reservations are a must, but the experience is worth every moment (and dollar). Can’t wait to go back; next time with the wine pairing. Highly recommend for special occasions or when you're in a “treat yo’self” mood.

Flavors were incredible. You could really taste each part of what they described when introducing the dish. Service also impeccable. The bartender was very skilled able to make a cocktail that is pretty niche and wasn’t on menu. Staff was incredibly friendly and our hostess fostered a warm environment from the moment we stepped through the door. Front of house looked like they genuinely enjoyed working in there and you could hear the intensity of the kitchen working too.

It was the most expensive meal of my life (so far?), but somehow it still felt worth it. One of the only tasting menus that have actually left me feeling full on top of the whole experience

They deserve all 5 stars, but the vibe isn't for me. Impeccable service, food flavors were really unique, beautiful and intimate space.

But the portions are really, really small. The tortellini was 2 tortellinis. I'm a big eater, and if you are you might want to arrive with a tizer in your belly because you're not going to cosume many calories over your 2.5 hour meal.

Bonus points for the wait staff looking like band members of Mumford and Sons.
customer_insights: Vetri Cucina is an upscale Italian restaurant known for its exceptional tasting menu and intimate dining experience. Guests rave about the creative dishes, attentive service, and elegant ambiance, making it a perfect choice for special occasions like anniversaries or first dates.

googleReviews:
What are the most remarkable dinner experiences of my life. The food is exquisite and is a work of art. The wait staff and the Sommelier are absolutely incredible. They are helpful and attentive but never in your way. They definitely added to the pleasure of the evening. The chef Nick came to our table several times just to make sure everything was exceptional. Yeah, you're not going to go there every week but it is well worth the money for everything you get. Cheers Nick, exceptional! Thank you.
Postscript: Congratulations on your Michelin star, you deserve it!

From start to finish, Provenance will continue to impress you with the presentation, complex flavor, and execution of their menu. The service feels like a gentle glove guiding you through your time there. It's incredible to have a restaurant this unique and of this caliber in Philadelphia.

My husband took me here for our 20th wedding anniversary and I was truly impressed with the presentation of courses and flavors and the excellent service. This was true art and clearly a chef dedicated to his passion.  I felt like I was living in a Picasso painting.  One of my most memorable dining experiences.  Can’t wait to go back!

Korean-inspired French fine dining — truly a unique experience. Every dish was thoughtfully composed, and I loved how each course came with a smaller, alternative interpretation of itself. While some of the flavors weren’t exactly to my personal taste (a bit heavy on watermelon and Korean sauces for me), the quality of preparation and execution was undeniable. Portions were generous — I was essentially full before the entrée.

The ambience was simple but elegant, with just the right lighting to keep things relaxed. What really stood out was the service: they greeted me by name upon arrival, the menu listed every team member involved, and the staff genuinely engaged with us from start to finish, even checking in ahead of time to make sure all our needs were met.

Overall, one of the most memorable dining experiences I’ve had — easily in my top 2 or 3 ever.

The complete experience for our party of four was exceptional. Our primary server, Diego, warmly welcomed us and saw to our every need, including little touches like proactively getting a small table on which to put my laptop bag. He had a great command of the drink offerings and was helpful with suggestions. All of the servers took care to precisely position our plates and utensils. They took turns clearly explaining all 21 dishes that were included on the tasting menu. The balance of flavors in each dish was remarkable and each was precisely presented. The chef visited our table at the conclusion of our meal and the restaurant called the next day to check to make sure all was perfect. It was.
customer_insights: Provenance offers a unique Korean-inspired French fine dining experience with exceptional service and artistic presentation. It's perfect for special occasions like anniversaries and first dates, but not suited for casual outings or large groups.

googleReviews: My wife and I went to Wilder on a lunch date and couldn’t have been happier with our experience. The decor and ambiance, service, and food are top notch. The ingredients in all our dishes were obviously very fresh and put together by very talented folks. I can’t recommend this place enough, especially for a date!

We went for Sunday brunch without a reservation. They didn’t have any tables available but offered us seating at the bar or bench. We chose the bench, which was comfortable enough for one or two people.

The service was excellent. Our waitress was patient and attentive. We ordered the Eggs Benedict and the Grilled Salmon Salad, and my friend had the Kombucha for drink. Both entrées were delicious; the salad was fresh, and the salmon was perfectly cooked. My friend liked her drink too.

For dessert, we shared the pistachio and cherry tart and ordered Jade tea (one pot was enough for both of us). The tart was fantastic, with a pistachio custard base that was especially good.

Overall, we were happy with our choices and the restaurant experience. Highly recommended!

Delicious dinner! What we ordered:

Crispy Calamari – The grapefruit and orange pieces with the frisée salad was surprisingly good with the crispy calamari. 5/5

Lamb Bacon Pizza – Chunks of lamb belly, toasted hazelnuts, fresh mozzarella, and pesto on a white sauce. The crust was excellent — light, chewy, and perfectly baked. 5/5

Mafaldine alla Vodka with Jumbo Lump Crab – Our unanimous favorite dish of the night (the photo doesn’t do it justice!). The housemade pasta was cooked al dente in a creamy vodka-tomato sauce with a generous amount of jumbo lump crab meat. I just wish there had been a touch more fresh basil. 5/5

Broccolini with Tonnato Sauce – A simple dish that was extremely well executed. The broccolini was crisp-tender, topped with crispy breadcrumbs. The tonnato sauce added a savory note that complemented the garlic and lemon. 5/5

For dessert, we shared the Double Chocolate Mousse, and our server surprised us with a complimentary housemade ice cream — vanilla and Earl Grey & plum swirl. I think it was because my 11yo son was with us and this isn’t the type of restaurant with a kids menu.

Overall, we had a wonderful dining experience — great food, great service, and a welcoming atmosphere. Highly recommend!

Celebrated two years of friendship with my friend and I loved it! Wilder did an amazing job with the ambience, food, service, I could go on!
Our host was absolutely fantastic! We came about 45 minutes before our scheduled reservation but she was kind enough to sit us early regardless.

Our waitress Bree, I hope I’m right was nothing short of perfection! From guiding us through the menu, giving us pointers on what she thought was the best and just ensuring we were satisfied-she did great!

I’d definitely be back again! It was 10/10

A Fantastic Spot for Birthday Brunch

Went to Wilder for a birthday brunch, and it did not disappoint. We were a large group with a reservation, and the staff was incredibly accommodating and welcoming throughout. The service was attentive and friendly, helping everything run smoothly despite the group size.

The food was excellent—fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. It’s clear that attention is paid to both quality and detail.

Based on this brunch experience, I’d love to come back and try their dinner service sometime. Definitely a place I’d recommend for any occasion, especially if you’re looking for great food, service, and a relaxed, stylish atmosphere.
customer_insights: Wilder is a highly recommended upscale dining venue in Philadelphia, known for its fresh ingredients and attentive service. The atmosphere is perfect for romantic dates, celebrations, and brunch gatherings, making it a versatile choice for various occasions.

googleReviews: My experience at the Alpen Rose went over all my expectations. The food here was absolutely amazing. The service in the staff were great. I mean I cannot talk better. The bone marrow was one of the best I’ve ever had just done so well I think the T-bone was great. I think it could’ve been better, but there’s always improvement to be made the beef. Wellington was amazing really done. Well I would have to say the service was absolutely amazing very kind, but not overly pushy and had a great recommendations. I would definitely recommend coming here.

Appetizers: I highly recommend the bone marrow and oysters. Bone marrow is a personal favorite anywhere I go, but the oysters were fresh and delicious.

For the main meal, I got the porterhouse was disappointed, the filet side was dry, and the NY strip side had no flavor or seasoning. However, my friend ordered the ribeye which I sampled a few bites and it was perfection.

Dessert: I ordered the Pineapple Upside Down Alaska, and was not appeased, I recommend to get the Ice Cream Sundae if going as a group.

The ambience inside the restaurant was phenomenal. Alpen Rose has a beautiful interior design and noise level was relatively low making it easy to talk to company.

Yummy meal and great atmostphere.  Highly recommended!  Alpen Rose has been on my list for a while and glad we did it!

Food:  VERY tasty steak.  It was the first time I had beef wellington so I had no point of reference but the meat was super tender and cooked perfect.  Other dishes was good as well.  Husband's steak was cooked well as well.

Drinks:  Cocktails and wine was great!

Service and atmosphere:  great service.  We look forward to coming back and trying more.

Recommendation:  definitely split the beef wellington and another main dish. Almost each table ordered it and I could see why!

Went for a birthday dinner and had an amazing experience. Service was absolutely top notch. We ordered the Parker house rolls and wedge salad to start, as well as two cocktails which were a good value for the quality.

For our main we shared the porterhouse and it was PHENOMENAL. The pickled shallots and garlic confit were a lovely touch. I also really enjoyed the house steak sauce and fermented chili sauce they provided. We also ordered the onion rings, asparagus, and pave potato. My only note is our fault in that  we over-ordered and should have gone with just two sides. Truly can’t go wrong with anything on the menu.

The ambiance of the restaurant is unmatched. A really unique, cozy space. It’s a wonderful place to celebrate a milestone or special occasion.

We had a reservation last night to celebrate us getting married that day. We are completely happy that we chose to do so.  From the cocktails to the amazing food we were thoroughly impressed. We split the Tomahawk steak which was perfectly cooked! All the apps and sides were equally delicious and done exceptionally. The ambience is exactly what we were hoping for! Was not disappointed in the slightest! Highly recommend this place!
customer_insights: Alpen Rose in Philadelphia offers an upscale dining experience with a focus on high-quality steaks and exceptional service. The ambiance is cozy and perfect for special occasions, making it suitable for anniversaries and first dates. While the menu features standout dishes like beef wellington and porterhouse steak, some items may vary in quality.

address: 210 W Rittenhouse Square, Philadelphia, PA 19103, USA
googleReviews: Wow amazing food. Don’t be fooled by the appetizers or starters being smaller or the desserts are delightful. The main course the steak I had was superb and the Bordeaux was exceptional. $80 for a bottle or $21 a drink reasonable. We had a business dinner with a client. We all were staying at different hotels and we did not have any reservations but they took great care of us. Rittenhouse has several great restaurants. Bon appetit

My past few dining experiences at other restaurants in Philadelphia were so grossly substandard.  I was so pleased with my dining experience at Lacroix, it reminded me of an era when I could call Philadelphia the 2nd best place in the States 🇺🇲 for good eats. The food was immensely fresh, the presentation was immaculate.  Service was precise, and punched well above its weight. The restaurant is beautiful, and while not remodeled, it has retained a timeless look. If you are looking for a sure thing, Lacroix is your destination.  Truly outstanding 👏

The most relaxing experience ever!!
Delicious varieties, amazing service.
Love, love, love!
I have already locked in reservations for New Years Day brunch
Cant wait to get back!!

Lacroix is a beautiful restaurant located on the second floor of the Rittenhouse hotel. We had drinks and appetizers at Bar 210 within the restaurant one day as well as breakfast one morning in the main dining room during our weekend stay at the property. The food was great, and the service was excellent during both of our visits!

Review for Brunch only.
The selection of food, quality of each dish, service and friendliness of the chef were impeccable. Nothing bad here at all. The meal felt exceptionally relaxed. The servers were attentive without being overbearing (a hard balance which was perfectly executed). The sizes of each dish were perfect for allowing a taste of everything. The staff were proactive in making sure every option was always available. The chef in the kitchen was great explaining it each of the roast dishes available and was very friendly. The quality of the coffee is a good way to judge a brunch, and the coffee was great. An exceptional experience.

Note: Review does not apply to afternoon tea (my experience of afternoon tea here over a decade ago was poor, I still have yet to find a place outside of the UK that can provide even an average afternoon tea).
customer_insights: Lacroix Restaurant at The Rittenhouse offers an upscale dining experience with a focus on fresh, seasonal ingredients and impeccable service. Guests have praised the beautiful ambiance, making it a perfect spot for romantic dinners, anniversaries, and brunches, though it may not be suitable for pregame or late-night outings.

googleReviews: Been here twice. Once for my birthday then on Valentine's Day 2019. Omakse was perfect. Waiter was knowledgeable, food was delicious. Atmosphere perfect. Second time we ordered from the menu.

The food was phenomenal from start to finish. Every piece of fish melted in my mouth. We sat at the bar and still had a welcoming and friendly experience. The bartenders were attentive without being pushy, and the atmosphere felt warm and relaxed. The place looked like a fancy space ship in the best way, which made the whole experience feel fun and unique. Everything we ordered was fresh and full of flavor. This was one of the best dining experiences I have had in a long time, and I would return without hesitation.

We had such a great dinner at Morimoto. We started with the hot stone Wagyu — it was incredible. The beef practically melted in your mouth, and cooking it on the hot stone right at our table made it such a fun experience.

We also ordered the spicy tuna crispy rice — so good! The tuna was fresh and had just the right amount of heat, perfectly balanced with the crispy rice.

My husband had a Japanese beer and my 11-year-old son got a mocktail called the Mandarin Ginger, which he said was really tasty.

For our main entrée, we got the crab fried rice with the broth on the side (which we were glad we did, since the broth was pretty spicy). The rice came out piping hot, perfectly seasoned, and packed with generous chunks of king crab. The broth had some imitation crab, and overall, the dish was delicious.

We also tried three sushi rolls — shrimp tempura, California, and eel & avocado. The shrimp tempura roll was nice and crispy, though it came with green beans, which we didn’t love. The California roll was honestly one of the best we’ve ever had — made with real crab and plenty of it — and the eel and avocado roll was excellent too.

For dessert, we got the fiery flourless chocolate cake. The presentation was amazing — they pour flaming rum over a chocolate dome, which melts to reveal a hidden layer of miso caramel ice cream. Underneath was rich chocolate cake, chocolate mousse, caramelized bananas, and a crunchy graham cracker crust. It was delicious!

The restaurant itself is beautiful, with lighting that changes colors throughout the meal. Service was friendly, professional, and attentive.

Overall, we had a fantastic experience at Morimoto and would highly recommend it!

Sensational! I tried their tasting menu and top to bottom it was fantastic. The staff guided me through each meal and were super knowledgeable about what went into each dish. The sweet corn crab soup and the olive wagyu were two of the most sublime dishes I've ever had. This is a must try tasting menu!

Our entire group had the Omakase.  Highlights were the Toro Tartare and the A5 Strip.  The A5 was outrageously flavorful, more than any other meat I have had.  The only time I had any beef that was comparable was the last time I had the Omakase at this same location. Service was a little slow.  Would not have been a problem if we didn't have to get on the road, but I guess that's on us for not addressing it.  One of my favorite restaurants.
customer_insights: Morimoto in Philadelphia offers an upscale dining experience with a focus on high-quality sushi and omakase. The atmosphere is described as warm and inviting, making it ideal for romantic dinners or special occasions like anniversaries.
