***** UPDATE
I went back received my refund and decided to try a burger and fries it was absolutely amazing!! The woman Anna was extremely greatful I decided to try again and am songreatful inside as well! Very happy customer will definitely be ordering again. 👌

Extremely disappointing experience. The staff showed no sense of hospitality or basic courtesy. When you work in a place that serves people, the least you can do is treat guests with respect. Won’t be coming back.

Thisnis my neighborhood spot. I ordered a chicken blt wrap waffle fries and a burger. The wrap was very fresh, fries were a Lil burned but still good. To my surprise the burgers come in 2s. Great prices. Fast delivery. Definitely will order again.

Ordered from here for the first time a couple months ago and then again this past weekend and like it. Food is very tasty and good sized portions. Like a local pizza shop but with varying options including Ethiopian dishes, salmon or lamb tacos, etc. So far, I've tried the Salmon Tacos, Salmon Burger and Southwestern Chicken Egg rolls - all have been good.

Now that I'm living a little closer, plan on ordering from them more often. Suggest giving them a chance and ordering from them.
customer_insights: Zuzu's Kitchen is a neighborhood favorite known for its Ethiopian offerings, particularly the meat combo. While some customers have experienced inconsistencies with menu items, the overall vibe is casual and welcoming, making it a suitable spot for a relaxed meal with friends.

googleReviews: Ethiopian grocery store. Ethiopian spices and traditional Injera, and groceries.
best store ever!!
Your coffee was disappointing, and I wish to give it a zero-star rating. It really upsets me.
customer_insights: Merkato Baltena is primarily an Ethiopian grocery store, offering traditional spices and Injera. While it has received praise for its offerings, there are mixed reviews regarding the quality of certain items, such as coffee. It is not a typical nightlife venue, making it less suitable for social gatherings or dining experiences.

googleReviews:
Wonderful food, atmosphere and location!

Our reservation was for six people and we were promptly seated. Our server was efficient friendly and knowledgeable of all the menu items.

Our drinks were delicious and I would really a Coconut Mojito. Delicious.

Brunch was served quickly and the portions quite generous.

Definitely a go to restaurant for a delicious meal, breakfast, lunch or dinner, while in Philly.

We went to Mixto for dinner on Friday night for the first time. The menu was presented on a computer tablet which was unique. The menu items had pictures and were presented nicely. My wife ordered the Ribeye and I ordered the Ropa Viega. The food was presented nicely and was very inviting. My Ropa Viega was great. I loved the taste and how it was prepared. Unfortunately the Ribeye was horrible. It was the most expensive item on the menu, but was the cheapest meat that you could find. It was prepared fine, but the quality of meat was bad. Hard to chew and had a lot of knots in it that got stuck inbetween teeth. So you can imagine. Ribeye is usually very tender and easy to eat. Not this one. I would stay away from this totally.
The menu has a lot of nice choices, so there is plenty for you to pick from pork to seafood.
The service was unusual. Our waiteress was sitting at the bar and chatting with other employees and eating, while we were waiting for service. I finally had to get up and ask her to come by and bring our bill.
Atmosphere is nice and romantic, but the service not compatible with the vibe they are trying to create.
I would for sure like to try the other dishes on the menu, but the service and quality of the food made me scratch this one from the list of places that would warrant a second visit.

Went to Mixto's to celebrate mom's 80th bd.  We were served by the wonderful and pleasant Adriana.  I started with Guacamole with plantain chips which was a pleasure.  The entrée was Churrasco Argentino and it was ordered medium which was tender and had great flavor.  Pashion Fruit mojitos complimented the meal and atmosphere perfectly.

This restaurant is located in a lovely area. The food is good, and surprisingly, the coffee was great too which is a pleasant surprise since many restaurants don’t serve good coffee. However, the service could use improvement; during my 40-minute visit, I was attended by three different servers, and their attitude wasn’t very good. Aside from that, this place is still a nice option to dine with friends or even on your own.

Just came here with friends visiting from NY. They loved it as they can't find Cuban food easily. The summer drinks were on point. Nice, cold, and fruity. The day was nice, we were sitting inside with the doors open. The food came out quickly. They serve large portions, so I recommend sharing plates / ordering few apps if you don't want to be stuffed. The price is a little higher so I don't recommend this as an everyday restaurant, but great for special treats/occasions, or happy hour.
customer_insights: Mixto Restaurante offers a vibrant atmosphere with a focus on Cuban cuisine, making it a great spot for various occasions, from casual brunches to romantic dinners. While the food quality can be inconsistent, the generous portions and unique drink offerings, like their mojitos, are highlights that appeal to both locals and visitors.

googleReviews:
I had an amazing experience thanks to my waiter, Richard. From the moment we were seated, he was incredibly attentive, polite, and welcoming. He made sure we had everything we needed without ever making us feel rushed. His timing was perfect, his recommendations were spot-on, and his positive attitude genuinely made our visit so much better.

Richard went above and beyond to make sure our meal was enjoyable—from checking in just at the right moments to keeping our drinks full and making sure our food was exactly how we wanted it. You can tell he really takes pride in his job and cares about his customers’ experience.

Thank you, Richard, for your excellent service. I would definitely come back because of you. !

Our waiter Manuel was amazing! The golden breeze mocktail was so good! The mamajuana sushi roll and the chicken empanadas were phenomenal. For our meals we got the picanha and the skirt steak both came out medium just as we asked. For dessert we had the coconut tres leche. Seriously the absolute best!!!!! Get yourself to this restaurant asap! We will definitely be back!

Absolutely amazing. The food, the service, the people and the overall experience was top notch. Great way to spend our anniversary. Thank you guys for such an amazing experience. Definitely coming back soon for more great meals and experiences.

This is my new favorite restaurant, rivaling some of my favorite restaurants in the Dominican Republic. Mamajuana makes me proud to be Dominican 🇩🇴. The food was amazing, the restaurant is gorgeous, valet parking, and our waiter Manuel was so attentive. Can't wait to come back again! and again!

My dad and I came for dinner last night. I literally have NO complaints!! Not even one!! Everything was amazing! Manuel was our server; very polite and professional! Even though we were early for our reservations, we were seated promptly. There were so many people there yet, no one was on top of each other and the food came out hot and fresh! Great job everyone! We will be back

Edit: I came back; it was still amazing 🥹☺️ and this time they sang Happy Birthday to me 🎉 thanks again
customer_insights: Mamajuana Cafe Philly offers a vibrant dining experience with a focus on Dominican cuisine. Guests frequently praise the attentive service, particularly highlighting servers like Richard and Manuel, who enhance the overall atmosphere. The restaurant is well-suited for various occasions, including dates and anniversaries, thanks to its upscale yet casual vibe.

address: 1739-1749 N Front St, Philadelphia, PA 19122, USA
googleReviews: Came here to celebrate a birthday and I’m happy I did! The ambience was great, and I liked that they give you some choices in terms of seating ( bar area, booth area, indoor or outdoor). The waiter was excellent, and helped us pick some of the menu items ( he even let us sample the margarita before deciding ). The snapper and nachos were great! I would definitely be coming back

LMNO was such a great new find in the city. We met here with a few friends and had a blast. The atmosphere was great, open, relaxed, yet elevated. The food was incredible. Highly recommend the guacamole and the chicken tacos! This would also be a great spot for a happy hour or first date at the bar.

I had an amazing time at LMNO for brunch. I had the vegan item on the brunch menu with I added jalapeño to it for some spicy and the taste was delicious. The strawberry mimosas were also good. I would definitely go back. I did wish the had a dj to have the full brunch experience like other brunches I’ve gone too. If you want just a relax vibe then this is the place for. Nonetheless, I would go back

We had a phenomenal and wonderful time at LMNO. We went there right after work for Happy Hour and appetizers. Our bartender Courtney was so professional, attentive, and kind. All the food we ate was so tasty and delicious. This place had such a fun and uplifting vibe, and we look forward to coming back soon.

You never know if restaurants are good because of the ambiance or the food…LMNO has both!! They did not disappoint!! I had the veggie al carbon and my friend had the snapper chicharrón. Absolutely phenomenal. Great flavors and textures. Definitely worth the price. Service was quick. Staff were patient and helpful! I’m excited to return and check out their lounge!
customer_insights: LMNO offers a vibrant atmosphere with excellent food and service, making it a popular choice for casual gatherings, brunches, and happy hours. Guests appreciate the variety of seating options and the relaxed yet elevated vibe.

googleReviews: I went here 4 different times and 3 outta those 4 times was a good experience. The last time I bought food, rice tasted burnt, the amount of food was a lot smaller than the 3 other times I came here. And I asked for chicken cutlet, they gave 3 chicken tenders that were probably frozen from the store. Nice staff and all but a huge disappointment the last time I went there.
Finger linking good!! Dominian food at its best!! A treasure ...quient and friendly atmosphere...a feeling all welcome...get more for your buck!!😁😁😁

I’ve been eating Latin food all my life.  Passed this restaurant so many times that I had no order choice but to stop in this time because I was hungry.  I’ll tell you what, if you are into eating great food, meeting awesome people and spending hard earned money…do all of those things right here!  The food here is cooked with Love!❤️.

El Fogon is the first Dominican restaurant that I've ate at since moving to Philadelphia and can honestly say I enjoyed the food and the service. The staff were very friendly and the restaurant was very clean. The music was a little loud so it made it a little difficult to hear the person taking my order but regardless, it was good food.

Me and my partner stopped here tonight on a date - we had no expectations. But y’all let me tell you!! The staff was very nice and accommodating. We got bistec encebollado, arroz, habichuelas, jugo de parcha y tamarindo, and some tostones. Our mesera even offered us potato salad - it was so good!
The meat was tender and juicy, the beans were seasoned perfectly, highly recommend!!!!
customer_insights: El Fogon Latino Restaurant offers a warm and welcoming atmosphere with a focus on Dominican cuisine. While most reviews praise the food and friendly service, there are occasional inconsistencies in food quality. It's a great spot for casual dining and meeting friends.

Great food and great people. The portions are very filling and the food is delicious. The people are very attentive and alert.
The best food hands down in the area omg the pernil and the yuca so good and if you get a chance the lemon juice is amazing 10/10 for me

I really like this place, they have food is really good and I pretty much only go there on Wednesdays because they have oxtails and it's amazing my whole family loves them sometimes they'll switch the days up on me which kind of sucks but other than that the prices are really good the people are polite and they abide by the coronavirus pandemic stuff so that's good
budget_friendly_items: mangu with cheese, eggs, and salami
customer_insights: Restaurante Latino Lela is a casual dining spot known for its affordable and flavorful Latin cuisine. Customers rave about the generous portions and friendly service, though there are occasional inconsistencies with certain dishes like chicharrón. It's a great place for a laid-back meal with friends or family.

googleReviews: We loved our experience here. My absolute favorite was the flan with papaya. I really enjoyed the red snapper as well. The drinks and meals were so flavorful. While on the pricey side, for $55/person the prix fixe included 3 courses. The atmosphere and service were both great

I literally cannot say enough good things about this place! My friend and I came here and sat at the bar for dinner and it was one of the best last minute dinner experiences I’ve had in such a long time!

First of all, our bartender/server, Perkins, was so accommodating and gave us some incredible recommendations for food and drinks. We loved everything he suggested. The service was phenomenal, the entire team here is incredible and so friendly and welcoming.

The habichuelas were spectacular, and we also ordered the ceviche sampler with the salmon, snapper, and shrimp. The snapper was the star of the show for sure, I would come back just for that. I highly recommend the Pin Pin and Rumba Rosa for cocktails. I will 10000% be back because I want to try everything on the menu now. And honestly, I would also choose to sit at the bar again because it was such a fun and enjoyable experience.

Visited Bolo for my anniversary dinner last night. The food? 10/10. The service? Easily like 6/10. Our server probably visited our table a total of 4 times during our 2 hours stay. Our server was at the bar entertaining other guests a good 75% of the time that we were there. He even took a shot with said guests while we were waiting for our food. There were only about 8 other guests in the restaurant, so I wasn’t too sure why it took so long for our chicken to come out? Another employee came over and gave us Fufu on the house to makeup for the wait, which was fine, I just had trouble understanding how we waited so long for our food for there to only be 8 people in the restaurant.

Upscale Puerto Rican cuisine made with care and high level presentation. We made reservations. Romantic atmosphere. Suckling pig option was delicious and had lots of side dishes, but I’m not convinced it was worth the price tag of $65. The bread and cheese option from the appetizer list was excellent: desserts are worth sharing too. Our server was friendly and attentive. Overall on the pricey side, but it’s a great experience.

Went here last week for my birthday. Food was incredible. We did several of the small bites. The ceviche shooters were my favorite. I’m not a fish lover but when it’s fresh and I can’t even tell it’s fish, I’m a huge fan. The yuca was crispy and delicious. The drinks were also really good. Logan was our bartender and he was the best part of the evening. Not only did he make a mean cocktail, he also invented one to cater to my tastes. I was so impressed and so thankful for his attention and care. I would highly recommend Bolo and urge you to make sure you get a drink from Logan.
customer_insights: Bolo offers an upscale dining experience with a focus on Puerto Rican cuisine, known for its flavorful dishes and excellent service. While some reviews highlight inconsistent service, the overall atmosphere is romantic and perfect for special occasions like anniversaries or first dates.

address: 2725 N American St, Philadelphia, PA 19133, USA
googleReviews: If this was just based on service.... I would give this place 5 stars. Every server checked on us. Every server got an order from us. Every server took an empty dish from our table. The hostess could have been alil more friendly but everyone else.. all smiles..eager to meet our needs. Nothing was too big of a request. The drinks were amazing. I ordered their new Mango Remy mojito...Delicious! The passionfruit margarita was one of the best I ever had. The steak with onions and rice and gandules... Wow! My boyfriend got the chicken in lemon butter... Out of this world! We definitely said we need to come back during the night night. They had hookah available as well. The booth were cozy and private. You must try this place!

I had my birthday party here. Fred, the owner of this nice place, along with his team made sure my party of 25 was well taken care of. Food was great. I ordered the Pull Pork! Delicious! Dj was playing amazing Spanish music so bring your Salsa Dancing shoes!

This was my very first time here.  I had a great time with my lovely date. The vibe inside was electric. But the thing that stood out to me most was the service.  My 2 servers constantly checked on us to make sure we were satisfied and if we needed anything else to make our stay more enjoyable.  You gotta come see for yourself.  The only reason why I didn't give it 5 stars is because it took a while for our food to come out. But once it arrived,  it was worth it. I had the red snapper.  The presentation was so real that it almost made the fish seem still alive on my plate.  I enjoyed the decor, the many TV screens,  even one at your personal booth and the DJ was on point and took special latin requests after a nice tip I felt obligated to go him because he was so gracious.  I recommend checking this place out. No riff raff either. This is a place you can take your lady to.

Been here many times over the years. like many places in philly, once they start getting really popular, the food and service start to suffer. theyre still a good 3.5 overall but i definitely dont go here as often as i used to.

Food is soooooo good! Love the arroz con gandules and arroz con camarones in the cute oyas. Steak is tender. Ceviche is so fresh and yummy! Ropa vieja sooo good!!!  Reasonable prices. Always something happening and they do a lot for and in the community. Happy hour 3-6pm, Taco Tuesdays 2 for $5, Thursdays karaoke, Free salsa lessons on Tuesdays at 8pm, comedy shows and live music on various weekends and they go ALL OUT for holidays w decor...big celebration coming up for Cinco de Mayo. An oasis in the community! Big space & 10 mins from Center City. Took friends there for my birthday and they ALLLLL loved it and some even ordered food to take home. They host events, fundraisers, birthdays. Many community leaders frequent the restaurant and host their events here. Plenty of free parking. Welcoming & fun atmosphere w professional & courteous staff. Stylish decor where can have privacy in a booth, a large table of friends, or sit around the bar which is always packed. They also have hookah.Highly recommend! And kid-friendly w plenty of FREE parking!
customer_insights: Izlas Puerto Rican Cuisine in Philadelphia is a vibrant spot known for its excellent service and delicious traditional dishes. With a lively atmosphere, it offers a variety of events including karaoke and salsa lessons, making it a great choice for both casual dining and nightlife.

googleReviews:
I love not having to look at a menu and figure out what dishes I can eat. This restaurant is all vegan.

I am vegetarian and my friend I went with eats meat. Both of us loved the food. we got cocktails and they were both delicious. I got the classic marg and it was very good!

We got the sweet plantains, Philly cheesesteak empanadas, Spanish meatballs, oyster mushroom tacos, and the jackfruit carnitas tacos. The sweet plantains were delicious! All the other food was very good too. The jackfruit tacos had a bit of kick to them.

I have never been disappointed! Service is always great, and food always delicious. This time, we had the nachos (they were out of the jack fruit pork, but the “beef” was quite good), the buffalo cauliflower tacos, and the hearts of palm “fish” tacos. I swear, the hearts of palm tacos are hands down the best tacos I’ve ever had, including tacos I had before being vegetarian/vegan! Ended the night with a horchata with rum and it was AMAZING. By far my favorite restaurant in Philly, and I’m excited to return again soon!

Our first stop on a recent weekend in Philly was brunch at Bar Bombon. From the moment we arrived, we felt welcome and relaxed. Our server, Nico, was great—attentive but patient and extremely friendly (which certainly added to our experience). We had such a pleasant time that we returned on Monday evening for $5 Margarita Mondays! Don't miss this casual and fun neighborhood spot–especially if you're vegan (but don't be afraid to bring the omni friends & fam)!

Marlo was awesome!! Attentive, but never hovered, answered all of our questions with a smile, made sure we had what we needed. Just overall a fantastic waitress!! I hate to say it but the manager wasn't as friendly. We saw the manager and Marlo bump into each other, clearly an accident, Marlo kept apologizing while it looked like the manager was about to punch her. She didn't but it definitely gave us the vibe that the staff is abused. I try to give everyone the benefit of the doubt, maybe she was having a bad day but she definitely seemed to have a negative impact on the staff and the energy changed when she left (she's why I'm leaving 4 stars instead of 5)....do with that what you will, but remember happiness is a choice!

Anyway the food was great! We had a table of 5 and the young man (I didn't catch his name but he was shorter with dark hair and nice nails!) who seated us was super accommodating and made sure we were comfortable in our outdoor seating, which we had requested.

We devoured a few chopped salads, double burger, avocado toast and shared a plate of pancakes. No crumb left behind!! Everyone was satisfied and happy! My friends said the drinks were excellent too. Although the weekend unlimited mimosas were super tempting, I decided to behave myself.

If you like delicious Mexican food and great people watching I highly recommend a sidewalk table!! I'll definitely be back for mimosas and to eat my way through the menu.

Delicious food and nice ambiance. Food wasn't overly greasy or drowned in any sort of sauce. Prompt service too and just a great escape from the intense heat. Would definitely recommend if you're in the area!
customer_insights: Bar Bombón is a vibrant, casual vegan restaurant that offers a delightful array of Mexican-inspired dishes. With a friendly atmosphere and attentive service, it's perfect for groups, brunch, or a fun night out with friends, making it a great spot for both vegans and non-vegans alike.

googleReviews: I stopped by this little spot for a quick bite and ended up blown away! I ordered the grilled chicken wrap, veggie fritters, and a side of fries — everything was fresh, flavorful, and cooked perfectly. The chicken was juicy and seasoned just right, easily some of the best I’ve had in the area. The fritters were crisp on the outside and soft inside — absolutely delicious! The staff was super friendly, quick with service, and the place was spotless. Prices were very reasonable for the quality and portion sizes. This has definitely become my new go-to food stop — highly recommend!

Let me say: as a local investor in my preferred zip code. I love a quick snack and drink. They have several choices of empanada ranging from crab, shrimp, lamb, beef, steak, chicken with cheese and chicken kabobs. Fresh squeezed juice. I love my yuca and fries.
My daughter loves their empanadas so much. Come support our locals in the heart of Kensington.
I’ve been coming here for some years now and I love the Food. The Food is fresh & hot and the people are great. Any time I’m around that area I’ll definitely stop by and grab me something to eat
The empanadas and the Quipes were PHENOMENAL, Authentic and very tasty. Had the Camarones and Cocolia (Crab) Will be back again!!

This place was one of my favorite spots many years ago before the owner passed away. Food still served fresh. The location needs help. They have to clean up out front. Just because it's in kensington does not mean you don't have to clean up around the business. Take pride in your establishment.
customer_insights: DECOO Restaurant is a casual dining spot known for its fresh and flavorful empanadas and friendly service. It's a great place for a quick bite or snack, particularly popular among locals in Kensington.

My favorite bites were the beef tacos and sliders! Can't wait to come back.
**My friend and I enjoyed the happy hour so much our first time that we had to come back again. The food was still just as delicious, especially the sliders, tacos and empandas!

We stopped in with some friends for a late dinner.  We were all happy with the  menu options, flavor and portion sizes  of the food. The atmosphere was nice, I just thought it was a little loud and the servers were friendly. If I lived in the area I would definitely go back.

This was the second time my wife and I went to the Paladar latin Kitchen. They have some of the best salad around. I choose the shrimp Elote salad. A mix of kale and letuce with shrimp and beans. That was delicious. The shrimp were especially well cooked. I did not give a 5 for service, because despite our server being great, we waited a little too long to get our meal. The first time we came, it was the same. This is an area of improvement, but the wait was worth it.

Came during happy hour but already been here before for dinner. Service both times were excellent. Happy hour had great selection of food and the Brazilian stew at dinner was to die for. Would definitely come here again.
customer_insights: Paladar Latin Kitchen & 610 SOCIAL Bar + Lounge offers a vibrant atmosphere with a diverse menu featuring Latin-inspired dishes. While the food quality is generally praised, some dishes have received mixed reviews regarding flavor. The venue is ideal for happy hour gatherings and casual nights out, making it suitable for groups and socializing.

googleReviews: I go to Bodega regularly after work for Happy Hour with my gfs. It is never a miss always a hit! The service is amazing, food is amazing, abd the DRINKS are AMAZING! Today was a special day we were out celebrating my gf birthday who introduced me to Bodega and she is a regular and probably recommended half the city to go to the happy hour at Bodega! We were serviced by Jonathon who was the best by far making our spicy strawberry margaritas!

Food 8/10 lacked some flavor, atmosphere was nice, music was great although you can’t hear much in the back. Service could’ve been better, It was busy so i can understand the overwhelming feeling. HOWEVER our sever was not as polite and his frustration showed. After we ordered we wanted to co Toni’s to order other items, and when we asked about them his response was “it’s really busy, i cant take multiple orders only one.” So does that mean i cant order more items from the menu? We spent over 300 dollars and everytime we wanted to order something extra It translated as annoyed or bothered.

One of the best causal happy hour spots with a decent sized $7 everything menu. The margarita were so delicious and we had such a great time. The atmosphere is causal laid back and "just have fun" vibes. The tapas were all so good we got 2 of practically everything on the menu. The garlic shrimp with spinach is a fettuccine dish. It's absolutely delicious - must try! Lots of seating available but it does get quite busy and I see why!

Had a great time at the Bodega Bar & Kitchen.
The service is top Notch. The food is delicious. The atmosphere very pleasant. I would definitely recommend Bodega for good drinks and food. There is a Parking lot on 12st between chestnut and walnut for your convenience.

Came to the outdoor patio to celebrate a friend's birthday! Let's get into this happy hour menu...it reigned  supreme.  Blood organe mojitos were amazing 👏🏽 Veggie empanadas 👏🏽shrimp skewers👏🏽the service was perfect and the space was so cute and cozy. I was enjoying my vibe and forgot to get food pics. googleReviews:
Was recommended to El Vez by the concierge at The Ritz Carlton Philadelphia and have returned a few times since 2011.

ATMOSPHERE:
Modern, contemporary, young & fun.

BEVERAGE:
Frozen Blood Orange Margarita
Delish! Silver tequila, triple sec , fresh blood orange purée.

Mezcale Mule

Keoki Coffee

SERVICE:

OVERALL:
Great Mexican cuisine, good for late-night fun & dessert.

It is a really nice restaurant, nice vibe and atmosphere. We ordered the tacos combo for 2 people, the one you make your own tacos with grilled chicken and steak. For the high price, we expected more steak to come, but they put a few pieces,and a lot of onions and peppers. At the end, we had more tortillas and the dipping sauces,but not enough meat. Despite that, they were tasty. Next time, I will order chicken only. We came around 5p.m on a weekday so was easy to get a table.

My partner and I came to Philly for a couple of nights and stopped into El Vez for dinner one night. The atmosphere was fantastic, the staff was kind, and the food and drinks were great! We got the classic margarita, chips & salsa, tito santana guacamole, and tacos (birra & carnita).
SO. GOOD.
Food and drinks were also very reasonably priced. We'll be stopping in again when we're back in Philly!

Delicious food and great friendly service. Good sized portions. Tacos for two is a great deal. Chill vibes and cool atmosphere. Cool Photo Booth. Unisex hand washing area downstairs with the bathrooms. Queso and chips (fresh) were really tasty.
Amazing foods and service. Drinks were perfect. As well as appetizers and main course. Nachos were the best ! Our server was very attentive, friendly and professional will go again.
customer_insights: El Vez offers a vibrant atmosphere with a modern twist on traditional Mexican cuisine. Guests rave about the delicious food, especially the tacos and margaritas, making it a great spot for both casual outings and late-night fun.

googleReviews: They have some of the best food I ever had in a long time. The staff there are very kind. Their platters are a great size. It definitely gets your tummy satisfied lol. This is definitely my new to go spot when I have a taste for Latin cuisines.

Food was great, but look out for all the extra charges especially the bags and TIPS since they feel entitled to get one they automatically included even when you press none when the question popped up.

Food was good, large portions. Thank you.  The customer service could be better. I did not hear the person behind the glass panels and asked to repeat herself without success. I asked for a knife and both people where on their phone, I tried to get their attention multiple times and finally after gentle knocking on the counter, I was able to get their attention. I also suggest having eco friendly products. Even though we ate in, everything was packaged and there were plastic straws.

Food here has amazing taste almost like a dish you get from your Hispanic parents house. Everything is always clean and fresh. Super affordable too about $10 a plate I usually get some protein, rice, and sweet plantains. Your options can vary but price stays the same.

I'm a FL transplant & I just recently moved back home to NJ.  I know Latin food.  This is my go to place for lunch and dinner.  The place is busy so the food moves in and out of the kitchen and to customers quickly.  The food doesn't sit around long.  Everything that I've tried has been 5/5 stars.  I've picked up food about a dozen times.  The hot food display case is always packed with food with steam in the air.  The ladies are always friendly.  Come check them out.
budget_friendly_items: protein, rice, and sweet plantains for $10
customer_insights: Latin American Restaurant in Philadelphia is praised for its delicious, home-style food and generous portions at an affordable price. While the food quality is consistently high, customer service experiences vary, with some reviews noting a need for improvement in attentiveness.

googleReviews: Highly recommend this restaurant; it's a fusion of puerto rican and mexican food. They made some huge upgrades recently. Top notch food, service, and vibe. I can't wait to bring my family and close friends to experience this wonderful place in the neighborhood. 100% worth the trip to come check out this phenomenal family run restaurant and they have BYOB!

I had the Mofongo and it was easily one of the best meals I’ve had in a long time. The owner, Billy, could not have been kinder! He even brought out a complimentary dessert. Will be back for brunch soon!

I ordered flautas and a burger for delivery. Delivery was expensive in the app. I got charged $7 when I could have walked 5 min for the food but I chose to meet delivery person at the door and that didn’t even happen. My food was dropped off like trash in the streets. I normally don’t give a review but I tip the delivery person and it was bad service. Plus, the food was expensive and came in small portion. 3 flautas for $17? No avocado and rice as the online menu advertised ? Fries were soggy too. Took them 40 min to get the food ready too. Very disappointed by the experience sadly.
Good food. Good service. Enjoyed my time here . Would definitely recommend and will definitely be back to visit again. The waiter was very accommodating to my needy party.

When we first arrived, we were unsure if the restaurant was even open. The chairs were still on top of the tables, there was barely any food or drinks out front, and the place looked like it had just opened or was still getting ready for the day. Adding to the initial confusion, there were no printed menus available.

This Puerto Rican spot operates a little differently—they go by the motto: “You choose what you want to eat and we will make it.” While this made me a bit nervous at first, especially given the quiet and uninviting atmosphere, I decided to give it a shot.

We ended up ordering two plates: one with beef stew, rice, beans, and plantains, and another with grilled chicken, rice, beans, and plantains. Do note that plantains are charged extra. We also tried the chicken and cheese empanadas as an appetizer.

The food turned out to be delicious—flavorful, fresh, and generously portioned. Both main dishes were satisfying, and the empanadas were crisp and tasty. Prices were reasonable, and they accept both cash and card, which is convenient.

Overall, while the ambiance left a lot to be desired at the start, the quality of the food and fair pricing made it a worthwhile experience. If you’re open to a less traditional setup and prioritize taste over presentation, this spot might surprise you.
customer_insights: El Sabor Restaurant offers a unique fusion of Puerto Rican and Mexican cuisine in a casual, family-friendly atmosphere. While the food has received high praise for its flavor and quality, there are mixed reviews regarding service and delivery experiences. The restaurant is BYOB and is suitable for casual gatherings and brunch outings.

googleReviews: This is my first visit to El Rey. I was in town for work with a colleague and grabbed dinner. The decor looks like a retro restaurant and atmosphere has a cozy vibe. It was a Wednesday evening and the restaurant was  about half full with the bar seats occupied. They offer a Happy Hour menu with apps and drinks from 4-6pm. I ordered the Hibiscus Margarita. It was more juice and ice with some tequila. The Guacamole, Salsa and chips were very good. I had the Chille Relleno (only one served) which is my go to Mexican dinner. It was served with Black Beans and Cilantro Rice. I'm used to this dish being served with Tortillas to sop up the sauce or make tacos. Overall, a good experience.🌮🥑🍹

We had a great first experience here and will definitely return. Guacamole & chips were amazing! Probably my favorite part! Fajitas and enchiladas were delicious - fresh and flavorful. And I loved the ambiance and staff!

El Rey is a diamond in the rough! The food is incredible, our server Leila was extremely knowledgeable with all items on the menu and made us aware of all the specials. It was easy to have conversation with the family over our wonderful dinner, we highly recommend making this your next date night out!

I've been on a Mexican kick lately and trying some different places. Last week I tried El Vez, this week I came here. The tacos at El Vez were better, the tortillas at El Rey were weirdly thick and chewy, though the flavors were good. I had an insane chile relleno though, and the cocktails are great. The passionfruit marg was straight passionfruit, really tangy. I loved it, and $6 for HH is amazing, although I don't think the drinks were very strong. The barstools are also very comfortable. Usually I'm dying after like an hour and a half and I spent most of the night chilling here. There are some other menu items I'd really like to try so I'll be back.

Very tasty contemporary Mexican with great service. Drinks were delicious and the nachos were a huge winner for us. It was quite loud inside.

I’m also a little annoyed that the $5 Photo Booth doesn’t give you countdown and just starts taking photos so we have a very unprepared sequence of photos.
customer_insights: El Rey offers a cozy and vibrant atmosphere perfect for casual dining and social gatherings. Guests rave about the delicious guacamole, flavorful entrees, and enjoyable cocktails, making it a great spot for both first dates and group outings.

googleReviews: Food was really good and the portions was big! I bought this food for later so I ended up reheating when I got ready to try it. It filled me right on up!!

Every platter I ordered was very delicious, tasty and warm, ready to eat as soon as its delivered at your front door step,. Delivery guy, very friendly, good customer service.. This place is one of the most authentic Dominican restaurants I've been to so far! From the decor, the friendly staff and the food, everything was fantastic! Definitely looking forward to come back! Highly recommend!
$10 lunch special was a large platter of rice beans plantains and chicken. The chicken was amazing. Friendly and helpful staff and fast service

googleReviews: Went here for a second visit before heading to a show at The Filmore.  Made a reservation online, but it wasn't too crowded so we could have walked in without one tonight. We were seated and greeted immediately. The entire staff were very friendly and attentive. The bread and butter to start was fresh, warm, and scrumptious. We stared with 2 apps, a queso dip and an octopus salad which was on special. I would get both of these again in a heartbeat. The octopus was tender and not overly chewy. The queso was piping hot and delicious. We got the beef tacos and the salmon with shrimp special.  Both were hot, and well cooked. The salmon was not dry at all and the shrimp were fairly large. This place is BYOB which I consider a plus lol. Will be returning again when I'm in the area.

An exceptional experience at El Fuerte de Loreto
I attended the wine dinner and it truly exceeded my expectations. The service was outstanding—attentive, friendly, and professional throughout the entire evening. Every dish was excellent, beautifully presented, and perfectly paired with wines that elevated each flavor.
You can really feel the attention to detail and the passion for creating a memorable dining experience. I will definitely be back. Highly recommended!

Jonny and his staff treated our family to an unlikely Thanksgiving Day treat. Although traditional turkey dinner with all the fixins was on the menu, we went for Mexican and loved it!  From queso fundido to octopus salad; mussels marinara to  strip steak and spaghetti with crab, our combinations all tasted and smelled like home cooking- not my home, by the way, but a welcoming neighbor sharing his culture and craft.  Do yourself a favor and visit... Salud!

Wow!! Incredibly fresh and flavorful food that comes in perfect portion sizes and isn’t oily. We split the Tlacoyos and Chilaquiles and didn’t feel stuffed afterwards. Spice level was perfect and salsas tasted very homemade. Service is friendly and fast. Music was a bit too loud for me to comfortably have a conversation, but they were nice about lowering the volume when I asked. Would 100% come back.

Service was a little slow but attentive to my coffee levels, so much appreciated.

The ambiance was very family friendly.
customer_insights: El Fuerte de Loreto Philly offers a vibrant and welcoming atmosphere with a focus on fresh, flavorful Mexican cuisine. The BYOB policy and friendly service make it a great spot for casual dining, brunch, or pre-show meals, appealing to both families and groups of friends.

googleReviews:
Really great tacos!

Each bite tasted fresh and full of depth. The atmosphere felt warm and welcoming, and even though we sat at the counter we still felt taken care of. Went really early in the morning to eat so didn't get the atmosphere of what it's like packed with people. Obviously ordered the Barbacoa and it was amazing. Love the spice and texture fall apart amazing. Spice it up with the picked veggies and sauces nothing like it. Also chips and guacamole where an instant hit with the wife.

I found out about this place on Netflix and wanted to check it out for myself.  We all went down for dinner and each had a plate of tacos and a horchata. Everything was delicious! This place is truly a treat. The chef/owner was friendly and accommodating and could not have been a better hostess.  We were able to pay with card by ordering on their new computerized menu, instead of cash only - which undoubtedly makes it easier for the staff.  We did miss the traditional table service as the girl in the front was busy with take-away customers and wasn’t really available to answer questions (for example, you can only get three tacos with one type of meat and you can only order the Aqua Fresca even though the fridges have four different homemade drinks).  Still, the food is outstanding and once we were seated the service was excellent.  This place is definitely worth a visit for an authentic taste of Mexico in South Philly.
Barbacoa love lives here. These folks preach the gospel and today's sermon is soft, moist and delicious porky goodness. I had mine as a taco and can't wait to return.
customer_insights: South Philly Barbacoa is a beloved spot known for its authentic and flavorful tacos, particularly the barbacoa and pancita. The casual atmosphere and self-serve options create a welcoming environment, making it a great choice for both casual outings and first dates.

googleReviews:
El Chingon is doing something special with its food and flavor profiles. The aguachile ahumado was a true standout: smoky, vibrant, and unlike anything I have had recently. The ceviche tropical was another hit, super fresh and beautifully balanced, with a leche de tigre that was bright, citrusy, and drinkably delicious. We also really enjoyed the elote, al pastor tradicional tacos, and pollo taco, all well executed, flavorful, and satisfying.

One of the highlights of the night was the cocktail mix that you can pair with your own BYO mezcal or tequila. We went with the tradicional extra spicy version, which was bold and beautifully balanced. The slight effervescence from the Topo Chico gave it a refreshing, crisp lift that made it even more enjoyable.

There were a couple of misses. The charred crab tostadas leaned too fishy for my taste, and the Mexican sweet bread dessert was unremarkable and did not feel like it measured up to the creativity or quality of the rest of the menu.

The biggest letdown, though, was the service. While every staff member we encountered was kind and well intentioned, the overall experience did not flow well. We ordered everything up front (which many places request), but the pacing was rushed and awkward. Three large dishes, elote, ceviche, and aguachile, were dropped all at once, overwhelming our small table. I asked the kitchen to slow it down, but the crab tostadas came out immediately after, clearly already prepped, and there was literally nowhere to put them. We ended up asking our server to hold the dish.

There was a nice pause before our tacos arrived, which we appreciated. But once we finished, no one cleared our plates or checked in. Since we were on a date night, we did not mind lingering, but when we tried to order dessert and coffee (an espressonada) around 9:20, we were told the kitchen had closed at 9:00 and the coffee machine had already been cleaned. No one gave us a heads up, no one came by for a final check in, and that lack of communication left us disappointed.

The food is easily an 8 out of 10. But the service, though sweet, was more of a 4 or 5 out of 10. Having worked in hospitality and dined out often, I know how much timing and communication impact the experience. El Chingon has serious potential and a talented kitchen. If the service can match the quality coming out of the back, this place could easily be a go to.

Third or fourth time I visit this place. Foot and the flavor are Legit. Food is incredible, very delicious. Highly recommend it. Reserve a table on weekends. The wait staff is also very good!

BYOB. Very good margarita mix available if you bring your own T.

10/10 recommend it.

When you expect to have Mexican food, but you realize it’s a different kind of having Mexican food experience. A good surprise to me. Attentive service, cozy and clean environment. Will definitely be back!
The special was bursting with flavors cooked to perfection. Shrimp Sourdough tacos with pork thick slice fried onion and pineapple delicious! 😋 Coming back real soon

Omg this place is an absolute gem! From the moment we walked in, everything felt so warm and welcoming. The restaurant is spotless (like seriously pristine) and the little details in the décor made it feel cozy yet festive.The food? Out of this world!  Every bite was fresh, full of flavor, and beautifully plated (yes, even the guac looked too pretty to eat ). Service was beyond sweet —everyone had a smile and made us feel like family. 10/10 would recommend for date nights, family dinners, or just treating yourself to happiness on a plate. Can’t wait to come back!
customer_insights: El Chingon Philly offers a unique twist on traditional Mexican cuisine with standout dishes like aguachile ahumado and ceviche tropical. While the food receives high praise for its creativity and flavor, service inconsistencies have been noted, impacting the overall dining experience.

We had enchiladas suizas and seafood enchiladas.

Food was excellent, especially the nachos! Margaritas were delicious, service was wonderful, and the ambience was bright and cheery. Not terribly cheap but worth it for a nice night out.

Great Mexican food in Old Town. We wandered in almost accidentally and were pleasantly surprised. I had the Molcajete and my wife had the Mole. Both were delicious. Service was great and we really enjoyed our meal. Thanks!
Good food. Fine fajitas. Nice tart margaritas in a wide variety of options. Comfortable atmosphere. Friendly prompt service. Had a late dinner. Enjoyed it thoroughly.

We had a very good meal at Las Bugambilias in Aug 2025. On our menu was guacamole and pico, tamales, al pastor tacos, and an enchilada. Our favorites were the tacos and tamales, and while all of the food was good, we did feel like some components could use additional seasoning. The margaritas were completely customizable - liquor, favor, rim. We visited on a quiet night, so the noise volume was low, and the environment was welcoming and well decorated. The burrito bowl was really good and filling — exactly what you’d expect from a solid bowl. The salsa wasn’t very spicy, but still flavorful. Overall, great value for the money.

This restaurant is super cute! Traditional Mexican food with a modern interior design. The service was wonderful. Loraina at the cash register was super kind. She provided very good service. Food was absolutely delicious. The chips that came with the "guac and chips" were super tasty. Also on the counter they offer additional salsas for your chips or meal. Went on a Wednesday afternoon, so not really busy. Enjoyed the chilled atmosphere.
