The ambiance was nice on the outdoor patio. We had the carnitas tacos, they were good. The chicken and chorizo empanadas (a bit spicy), the guac was good but the serving was very small for two. The Esquitas were not the best.
We also ordered mocktail margaritas, they were decent.
customer_insights: Cantina Dos Segundos offers a vibrant atmosphere with a solid selection of Mexican cuisine, including vegan options. Patrons appreciate the outdoor patio and the extensive tequila menu, making it a great spot for casual gatherings and pregame outings.

googleReviews: Visited for the first time in August 2025, after having heard great things for years. We had a decent experience -- great food but small portion size. Friendly servers but more focused on putting on a show than being attentive to what we needed. Took nearly 20 minutes to order our food but not because anyone was busy -- they were just not paying attention to us. I prefer La Jefa and El Milpa on the other side.

Tequilas has always been one of Center City’s gems and one of my my favorite Mexican restaurants in the city. After being closed for a while due to the fire, it’s safe to say they’ve come back better than ever. The food is outstanding; each dish beautifully presented and layered with authentic flavors that feel both refined and comforting... From the tender barbacoa bathed in rich consommé to the fresh guacamole con atún and the indulgent queso fundido, every bite feels like a celebration of Mexican tradition elevated to fine dining.

The service deserves its own praise. You can tell the entire staff, like the servers, busboys, food runners, they all work seamlessly together as a true team. Everyone is attentive, warm, and genuinely passionate about creating a great experience.

Tequilas is not just a meal, it’s an experience- one that reminds you why this restaurant has such a loyal following in Philadelphia. I’m so glad they’re back, and even more impressed by how they’ve elevated every detail. Highly, highly recommend!

An incredible gem in the heart of Philly. The best authentic Mexican food I have had outside of Mexico, all served up by the remarkable staff. The owner's son came to greet us and told us about the history of the place, and took very good care of us. Would definitely come back!

It’s been years since I ate here, and before the fire and subsequent renovations. The place is beautiful. Service was great. Attentive and friendly.  We had margaritas and a light meal. All great. Loved the tamales and the molecajete. Will definitely go again. You should try

I had my birthday dinner here last night and it was a masterclass of an experience. Unfortunately, I only captured a photo of the ceviche and everything we ordered was 10/10. Can’t wait for us to come back here 😋. Thank you!
customer_insights: Tequilas Casa Mexicana is celebrated for its authentic and beautifully presented Mexican cuisine, with a strong emphasis on quality service and a vibrant dining experience. While some reviews mention issues with attentiveness, the overall consensus highlights the restaurant's commitment to providing an elevated dining experience that feels both refined and welcoming.

address: 2053 S Beechwood St, Philadelphia, PA 19145, USA
googleReviews: Visited this cute restaurant for the first time in July 2025 and absolutely adored it! We loved the authentic and homey feel of the dining room, and the food was wonderful! The Nopalito cactus soup was delightful (and spicy!),  the enchiladas mole were SO yummy, and the Guajillo Risotto was to die for! The horchata tres leches was light, fluffy, and a great way to cap off the meal. The servers were a little timid and confused at times, but overall we had a great time and can't wait to come back!

We have the most amazing experience here! We found this place on accident a few weeks ago and since been back. The service is 10/10 our waitress was so attentive and very sweet. If you are looking to dine at an authentic Mexican restaurant ( coming from a Mexican herself) look no further. Always bring some tequila they sell a wonderful margarita mix. Cannot say enough great things about this place!!! We will be back like always

The food at this Mexican restaurant is quite good, offering a diverse selection of dishes from risotto to octopus. While some options may not be entirely traditional, the restaurant adds its own unique twist that works well. The space is on the smaller side, so if you’re planning to come with a large group, it’s best to call ahead to check for availability. Keep in mind that due to the limited size of the kitchen, orders may take a bit longer during busy times, so a little patience goes a long way.

Absolutely amazing place, you could call it a hole in the wall. We had some apps and the burritos/tacos were absolutely delicious. Our friend had been raving about this place for a long time and I’m so sad we didn’t try it sooner. I’m already plotting when I’ll be back to dine again.  Pricing is so fair. So so happy with this place.

I had a good time at this restaurant. Everything was clean and the staff were really friendly. My friend and I started with the esquites appetizer, and it was delicious. Definitely a great way to kick off the meal.

For our entrees, I had the Parrilla Mexicana and my friend got the Mole Colorado. I really enjoyed mine—everything was seasoned well and cooked just right. My friend, on the other hand, wasn’t too happy with their dish. It only came with half a chicken breast, which felt like a small portion for the price. The rice wasn’t great, and while the beans were super watery, they actually tasted good. My friend ended up just eating the chicken and left the sides, so they were still hungry afterward.

Even though their dish missed the mark, I’d still come back and try something else. The overall experience was nice, and there’s more on the menu I’d like to check out.
customer_insights: El Mictlan Restaurant offers a cozy and authentic dining experience with a diverse menu that includes both traditional and unique Mexican dishes. While the service can be a bit slow during busy times, the friendly atmosphere and quality food make it a great spot for casual dining or a night out with friends.

googleReviews:
I recently visited this place, and overall the experience was good. The service was excellent — the staff were attentive and friendly. The food was decent as well, though I felt it could have been a bit more flavorful.
One thing that stood out was the size of the tables for two; they felt very small and a bit inconvenient. Additionally, the restaurant had a rather strong, very specific smell that was a little distracting.
Despite these minor issues, it was still a pleasant visit. Rating: 4-/5.

This place is top notch for so many reasons! It was 11:15pm, we had a party of 14 and we stumbled into this place and had an awesome experience! I think they close at Noon but they stayed open beyond 1am for us. The food was delicious, servers were attentive and the inside was decorated for Halloween in a way you have to see for yourself. The place is a vibe and the specials hit which is always the sign of a place I will comeback to!

Staff was very nice and attentive, the food was very good and spicy (at least for a white person), the tortilla chips were fresh and crisp, the complimentary salsa and verde was fresh. The dinner was amazing and filling. Will visit again when I get a chance.

Food was great. Hands down. Everything was yummy. Otherwise few pieces of feedback
- Sangria was gross
- Vibe in the back was cute but the front was weird
- Lots of mistakes in service
- Crazy added charges like $10 for a side of pico because it didn’t come with fajitas.

It’s sad when you see good food, but poorly executed in the front of the house.

Where do I even begin? Amazing service, delicious food and drinks. Incredible family owned establishment with top notch dishes. Chef Omar is my favorite, his finesse and attention to detail are second to none. I grew up in Southern California, and have traveled to Mexico many times. This is among the best food from that region I’ve ever tasted. 10/10.
customer_insights: Tamalex Bar & Grill offers a lively atmosphere with attentive service and a focus on flavorful Mexican cuisine. While the food receives praise, some customers noted inconsistencies in service and minor issues with the ambiance. It's a great spot for groups and late-night gatherings, particularly for those looking for a casual dining experience.

googleReviews:
We went here to celebrate some good news and it did not disappoint! The quesadilla and short rib dishes are out of this world - we plan to go back.

Very friendly service and nice vibe as well. Looking forward to checking out the cafe.

We noticed a good amount of people that seemed to be on first dates. It seems like a good spot for that.

The drinks were also very good and they had a wide variety of options.

La Jefa is a beautiful blend of Mexican tradition and modern flair in Rittenhouse.

The Garibaldi cocktails, especially the green apple and grapefruit, are refreshingly unique, with a light, fluffy texture that makes them perfect for brunch or happy hour.

The enmolados are rich and comforting, featuring crispy pork belly and fried eggs over mole-smothered tortillas. Every bite is layered with flavor and warmth.

The space is stunning, with a bright café up front and a relaxing speakeasy-style bar in the back. Whether you're here for coffee, cocktails, or a full meal, La Jefa delivers an unforgettable experience.

I almost hate to rave about this place because it'll be harder to eat here in the future, but this deserves a rave regardless. The food and drinks are rooted in Mexican tradition but driven by creativity, and if you want an amazing meal that will push what you consider traditional Mexican fare, this is the spot for you. The waitstaff are so welcoming and lovely, and the bartenders and chefs deliver such delicious and creative food and drinks. It's one more awesome Mexican restaurant in Philly, and the city is better for the more there are!

This place is so so good! The vibe is super cool inside. All the staff are extremely attentive and friendly. I loved the house-made sodas. Every dish we ate was delicious - flavor combos are perfectly designed and executed. I’ve also been here for coffee, and their alcoholic and cafe drinks are all excellent.

I NEVER write reviews but I have to write one for this incredible restaurant/cafe. I have been to a good number of restaurants and coffeeshops in Philly over the last eight years and I can confidently say that this is the best restaurant I’ve been to in Philly. It felt more like an experience than just brunch. The ambiance is unmatched, which is something that is really important to me. You can see that they spent so much time on making the space perfect. The owner seems to have a very clear vision. The service is top notch - I was struggling to cut my sandwich for two seconds and the waitress brought me a sharper knife immediately without me even saying anything. Everyone was incredibly kind and knowledgeable about the food/drinks. The food is so creative and tasty. There is no other place like this in Philly. Even the menu had details and impressive art on it. Go there now and you won’t regret it.
customer_insights: La Jefa Café offers a vibrant atmosphere that blends traditional Mexican cuisine with modern creativity, making it a popular choice for brunch and casual dining. The attentive service and unique drink options enhance the overall experience, making it suitable for various social occasions, including first dates and celebrations.

address: 1260 Point Breeze Ave, Philadelphia, PA 19146, USA
googleReviews: Very authentic ant tasty Mexican restaurant. We had guacamole and queso fondito (not pictured, it was so good I forgot to take a pic). Guac was very good too. Had the ribs and a steak, chicken and shrimp dish in a hot lava bowl. Both also recommended. The only drawback is the prices are a little high for the type of food. We had two drinks and one beer and a dessert. With tip and tax the meal was $180 for two.

The food is beyond expectation! Taco de pescado is full of corn flavor, fish fried at perfect tender, balanced with mango dices. Carnitas negras is thoroughly marinated with herb spice, big portion, with fresh lightly sour vegetable. Tortillas are freshly baked, excellent! Churros are harder than those from street carts.

This place is a diamond in the rough, truly a hidden gem. Excellent cocktails, ceviche, guac, nachos and pizza. We didn't have a chance to try the tacos or mains but they also looked incredible. Great service. Come here for mouth watering authentic Mexican cuisine but be warned that it will alter your standards when you're craving this fair. Will be coming back real soon 😋

Our first time here at this lovely restaurant.  We went for happy hour and it was great! Oscar, the bartender made a great margarita and an awesome sangria.  Alex, our server, was so professional and friendly.  I always ask a lot of questions, and he was not bothered at all.  The restaurant is bright, clean and the food is so very good.  The wings were cooked to perfection and their “secret sauce” really is delicious! The tacos DeTrompo were one of my favorites and to my surprise they have a brick oven and we also enjoyed a most delicious pepperoni and cheese pizza.  Oscar was also kind enough to let me taste his salmon, which he was being served and seeing to me it was cooked to perfection, I asked if I could try and he, just like I was family, gave me a sample, and it was so very good.  To top off our anniversary dinner, we shared a most delicious chocolate flan cake, which was absolutely fresh and delicious! Judy, another server came over to talk with us and she was so very nice.   So glad we visited this restaurant and hope to return again.  My compliments to the chefs, the food is delicious! Alex, Oscar and Judy, thank you for making us feel like family!

Best Mexican place in Philly. Feels like you’re at a Michelin Star restaurant without the prices. Special seasoning, delicious drinks, quick food and service. Service was cracking jokes, always making sure we were taken care of, they were 10/10. Highly recommend and will be my new spot food. They have outdoor seating, bar inside and plenty of seating inside. Ambience was great, amazing selection of dishes and drinks. They serve pizza as well if you aren’t in the mood for tacos. Happy hour tues-sun 4-6pm.
customer_insights: El Mezcal Cantina is a vibrant Mexican restaurant known for its authentic cuisine and lively atmosphere. Guests rave about the quality of the food, particularly the tacos and cocktails, making it a great spot for casual dining or special occasions.

address: Above Oyster House, 1516 Sansom St 2nd Floor, Philadelphia, PA 19102, USA
neighborhood: Above Oyster House, 1516 Sansom St 2nd Floor, Philadelphia
googleReviews: Absolutely delicious Mexican food & margs! Everything was so yummy, we got the barbacoa tacos & the fried mahi tacos, chips&guac, esquites, and fried artichokes. The margs are super strong and soooo good. They also have good non-alc options! The service was good, our sides took quite a while longer than our tacos to come out which wasn’t ideal but very minor. The restaurant itself was quite loud so maybe better for hang outs or younger ppl. Will def be back tho!

Still 5 out of 5. I love this place and love the menu. The service is always 10 stars. The food is still amazing. The atmosphere is still the greatest. This is always my first stop whenever I’m back in town.

Absolutely amazing gluten-free menu! Highly recommend the shrimp tacos, churros, and a spicy jalapeño margarita. Our family loves Mission Taqueria - all the staff are friendly, the food is fantastic, and it’s in a great location.
Always love when I can visit this spot while in Philly.  Staff is always friendly and the food is delicious & gluten free.  Definitely save room for dessert.
Solid and tasty food, fun times, good service. Ultimately not exceptional, but enjoyable and we will return.
customer_insights: Mission Taqueria is a vibrant spot in Philadelphia known for its delicious Mexican cuisine and strong margaritas. The atmosphere is lively, making it ideal for groups and casual hangouts, although it may not be the best choice for intimate dates or anniversaries.

googleReviews:
Phenomenal food and an awesome vibe! The nachos with "expensive cheese" with spicy pork, the birria ramen, and the fried plantains were incredibly good. The beer selection was nice here too.

We discovered this place by accident but were blown away by how good it was! We'll definitely be back.

Tasty Mexican food with a good spicy kick and Asian fusion elements. Cosy if slightly loud on a Saturday night but the happy hour crowd clears out by 7:30 and elegant tea candles come out. Attentive and fast service! The ramen was fine, spicy pork tacos and tortilla soup (spicier than the tacos actually) were delicious. However note the bathroom is on the 3rd floor which is not very accessible.
Very good food! Took a while to get it though and desert took way too long. Cool vibe here

Good bar! Ordered a few margarita pitchers with friends and they were strong! Got the guacamole as an appetizer but had to remind the server a few times that we were still missing it before it came out, after the entrees. Got the wings and they were full of flavor but could have used a little bit more sauce.

We loved the excellent variety of mexican dishes. We would order all of it again. We were with a 10 and 8 year old and they loved it too.
We ordered the Phillycheesesteak taco (3) and it was amazing.
the Freedom Taco - (3) classic was great as was the Rice Bowl with Chicken Tinga. Fish tacos were great too.
The guacomole was great but pretty spicy- a couple at our table couldnt handle it.
The Spicy Magaritas were amazing.

The place is dark and cozy but the music leaves a lot to be desired. The playlist was 90's lamenting white male whining rock. Not the best dinner music at all.
There are multiple sports playing on a few TVs which was typical but the music ( and I like 90s rock ) was a drag.
customer_insights: Jose Pistola's offers a vibrant atmosphere with a unique blend of Mexican and Asian fusion cuisine. The venue is popular for its flavorful dishes and strong drinks, making it a great spot for groups and casual dining, though service can be slow at times.

googleReviews: The food was absolutely delicious, full of authentic Mexican flavor! 🌮🔥 The restaurant has a warm and friendly atmosphere, and our waitress was amazing — super kind, attentive, and always smiling. Definitely coming back again! 💯👏

I really like this place. So I had to comment and say, whoever is cooking the lengua, make sure they stay as far away from this delicacy as possible. I order the lengua burrito and could not eat it because of how big, chunky, rubbery, and flavorless the meat was. It was extremely unappetizing I almost threw it away. Instead I stewed it like it was supposed to be, and saved it. Here is how it looked after i saved it. Not worth $20

Update: The meat .. something is wrong with your lengua. It was irredeemable even after re-alchemizing it. Still metallic and just bleghh. Ew. What did you do to it????

We had so much fun here. The staff is incredibly friendly and lively. We had a great time interacting with them. Not only that but the food was incredible. So delicious with a real authentic and home cooked feel. The prices were amazing especially considering the location. I could easily see this being a regular hang out spot. It had a lovely relaxed community vibe that the restaurant facilitates with its hospitality and personality.

Very nice mexican spot. The food was amazing. There were so many options to choose from. I got the hibiscus water....OMG! It was very refreshing and quenched my thirst. I had steak tacos and my boyfriend has the cow tongues tacos. There were no complaints. The fresh Pico was perfect. The corn was to die for. We definitely need to go back. The staff was patient with me while I couldn't decide what to order. The indoor was beautifully decorated. Outside were tables and chairs.

We went with friends on a quiet Tuesday for lunch, and my daughter and I shared the birria quesadilla (at my friend’s recommendation) and the quesadilla pastor (because it came with guacamole), and my husband got the shrimp tacos. When the birria with consome arrived, I was floored by the first bite, like, transported to another place and time level experience. The pastor was also very, very good and we really enjoyed everything else, including the flavorful salsas that come with the chips, the guacamole, the tiramisu and tres leche cake, all superb - but if you eat beef: Oh. My. God. This birria.
customer_insights: Don Barriga offers a warm and inviting atmosphere with a focus on authentic Mexican cuisine. While many patrons rave about the delicious flavors and friendly service, there are mixed reviews about specific dishes like lengua, indicating some inconsistency in food quality. Overall, it's a great spot for casual dining and social gatherings.

googleReviews:
Absolutely amazing place! We ordered the Fatboy Choose 2 set — and wow, it’s definitely more than enough for two people! Ours came with beef shawarma on the plate and juicy lamb chops, both cooked perfectly and full of flavor. The food was fresh, generous, and beautifully presented.

I also loved the black tea with mint, which comes with refills — a perfect finish to a great meal.
Everything was delicious, and I’m just genuinely happy with this experience. Highly recommend Cilantro Mediterranean Cuisine to anyone who loves authentic Mediterranean flavors!

Absolutely incredible experience! We traveled to Philadelphia specifically to eat here, and it exceeded all our expectations. The food was worth every penny – everything we ordered was fresh, delicious, and there was so much variety to choose from. The atmosphere was just as wonderful as the food. On top of it all, the service was amazing; our waitress was attentive, served our dishes quickly, and cleared plates promptly. We will definitely be back!

WOW!!!! Just WOW! We’re still sitting here drinking tea, as I write this review. Food was Phenomenal and service was outstanding! We got the cilantro mix for appetizer, that came in a very generous portion. At first, we thought we were not gonna finish it, but it was so good we got could not stop eating it. Second dish was the mixed grill for 1, which again was a huge portion and one meat better than the other. We also got the mint tea and had it with baklava. The baklava just melts in your mouth! We are definitely coming back here with our friends and our kids because it did not disappoint.

In the immortal words of the late great Scott Hall, hey yo! Cilantro is the absolute truth!!! It's 100% certified finger licking good God of almighty". I had the chicken swarma and cheese samosas. And my fiancee had a veggie 😋 swarma with some pita bread and humus. It was all good 👍. So well seasoned so fresh and great portion sizes. This place is 10 out of 10. They didn't miss nothing. Now I'm hooked on Cilantro's Mediterranean food. I highly recommend this place if you're ever in Philly and enjoy Mediterranean food you have to pull up.

Fantastic Mediterranean food!!! This is my first time trying Mediterranean food and oh my goodness it was sooo good. Nothing I had was bad, everything is amazing!!! Even the vinaigrette for the salad was great! The meats are tender and cooked to perfection. Hummus was so good with the pita bread too. In the end, all of us left with full belly. Will definitely come back for more!
customer_insights: Cilantro Mediterranean Cuisine in Philadelphia is celebrated for its authentic and flavorful dishes, generous portions, and attentive service. The casual atmosphere makes it suitable for a variety of dining occasions, from family outings to romantic dinners.

googleReviews: Great Greek food. Ordered Lamb loved it , but then tried my wife's chicken. I  liked that even more. Save room for desert.  Staff friendly, quick and attentive

Epic hummus. Drizzled with a little spicy oil and fried chickpeas…and yet retains the ideal texture. The accompanying pita bread was also exquisite.

The seabass was as good as the photos make it look.
This was one of the best meals I’ve had in the city. Everything was prepared perfectly. This was a top three salmon dish I’ve ever had in my life. Crispy, juicy, perfectly cooked. BYO.

Great place to celebrate birthdays!
Staff is so attentive and the food is spectacular!

Great BYOB with excellent offerings and quality food! The lamb kebobs were melt in your mouth and ever SOOOOOO tasty!

A great neighborhood jewel with beautiful people and great food AND vibes!

I'll be back... Again and again!
We ordered the tasting menu to try different items. The hummus and halloumi were delicious.
customer_insights: Kanella is a beloved neighborhood gem known for its exceptional Greek cuisine, particularly the lamb and seafood dishes. With a BYO policy and a warm, attentive staff, it creates a perfect atmosphere for celebrations and intimate dinners alike.

googleReviews: This place was really impressive. Very detailed flavor profiles that are executed with a high level of success. Fresh ingredients and intentional execution were undeniable with everything ate. This also extended to the drink menu as well. I don't know about others, we thought the service was equally superlative. I would highly recommend this one, especially if you are in the mood for a lighter meal.

It was a good experience,  but i just went to Her Place, so it is hardbfor me to give this place a 5 star. I think Google should increase to 10 point system!

Overall great food, nice flavor but nothing wowing.. i liked eggplant a lot. Now I am inspired to make morneggplany dish. I loved the peri peri shrimp.  I liked it so much forgot to take a photo. The shrimp was great texture. Asparagus was good, especially the sour mushroom on top. I will use more lemon in my cooking now too.

I did not like the steak small dish. The meat was dry and flavorless..

The service was good.  They are very anxious to clean my table, keep asking if i am done.. it was very interesting.

Final verdict: you should try!

What a gem! Spice Finch in Philadelphia absolutely blew us away. From the moment we walked in, the service was phenomenal – attentive, friendly, and genuinely helpful. We dove into their amazing small plates to share, and each dish was a burst of flavor and creativity. It's truly a fantastic spot for sharing and trying a variety of their offerings. And for all our plant-based friends out there, you'll be thrilled to know they have great options for vegans as well, which is always a huge plus. To top it all off, their drinks were expertly crafted and perfectly complemented the food. Spice Finch is definitely a five-star experience and a must-visit in Philly!

Found myself at this establishment this past Friday evening on a stroll out alone and decided to give it a go.

The space is vast with ample room at the bar to snag a seat and enjoy a beverage and a meal.

I was greeted by the bartender who was super sweet and extremely friendly.  He made a suggestion or two when I asked and was pleasantly surprised at the delicious concoction he prepared  for me.  The sugar rimmed margarita was so good I had 2.

Dinner was punctual and prepared exactly how the menu described it.  No surprise ingredients or sauces.

My only gripe, it would have been better to go here with someone or a small group.   The tapas looked and sounded amazing however eating solo there’s only so many dishes you want to order.

Def give this place a go!   It’s worth it

This place is a really nice, small, Mediterranean restaurant. The staff was pleasant, and my waiter was very knowledgeable about the menu and offered many great suggestions.

I had small plates and everything was absolutely delicious. I ate way too much because I just didn’t want to stop eating!

If you’re looking for great, tapas style or full dishes, Mediterranean food, definitely check out Finch!
customer_insights: Spice Finch is a highly praised Mediterranean restaurant known for its flavorful small plates and attentive service. Guests appreciate the variety of dishes, including excellent vegan options, making it a great spot for sharing meals with friends or a romantic dinner.

googleReviews:
Suraya absolutely exceeded our expectations on every level. The mezze selection was incredible - we couldn’t get enough of the dips, particularly the eggplant dishes which were perfectly seasoned and had amazing texture. The halabi kebab was a standout, cooked to perfection with wonderful spice balance.
The bronzino was fresh and beautifully prepared, and don’t even get me started on the desserts! The knafeh was absolutely divine - crispy, sweet, and the perfect end to an amazing meal.
But the food is only part of what makes Suraya so special. The open kitchen creates such a dynamic energy - you can watch the skilled chefs at work, which adds to the whole experience. And that giant back garden seating area is absolutely magical! The outdoor space has such a unique, vibrant atmosphere that makes you feel like you’ve been transported somewhere exotic.
The vibe throughout the entire restaurant is just incredible - from the bustling open kitchen to the lush garden, every corner has character and charm. This is more than just a meal; it’s a complete sensory experience.
We’ll definitely be back to work our way through more of the menu and soak up that amazing atmosphere again. Highly recommend for anyone looking for top-tier Middle Eastern cuisine and an unforgettable dining experience in Philadelphia

We tried the tasting menu at Suraya on a Saturday evening, and it was absolutely outstanding! Every course was thoughtfully prepared and beautifully presented , a true culinary journey through vibrant Beirut/Lebanon flavors. The portions were generous, and each dish complemented the next perfectly. The staff were attentive, knowledgeable, and made delicious recommendations throughout the meal. Suraya is the perfect spot for an exceptional dining experience

Overall this place is a solid middle eastern restaurant.  Food was “good” and the service was exceptional.  The choices in the preset menu provides us abundant choices.

We had a great time with the staff being very attentive.  However, we did have an issue with our table and its location as we were situated right by the door with patrons and especially staff constantly going in and out to the patio area on a cold night. I do not recommend using this table during colder months/days.  We also felt pretty cramped on a small table for a party of 8.

Top tier! Everything from the ambience to the service and food was truly great ◡̈ fave bites were the raw yellowtail app and the branzino entree. Both were impressively well-balanced in terms of flavor and texture! Also, the lover & lover espresso martini with cardamom foam is hands down the best drink I’ve ever had. Only thing I would change is having the kanafeh as dessert. It felt quite heavy, and we thought the salty cheese made it feel less like the sweet treat we were looking forward to having as the finish to our meal. Would 10000% go back!

Went for their brunch tasting menu and really loved it. Service was attentive and very accommodating to our wishes. The starters were very tasty and fulfilling. The pita is delicious and served fresh! We had samke harra and halabi kabab and both were really well made! The rose water lemonade was amazing too! And their bakery items also were so fresh and delicious!
I was very impressed how every little detail was designed well in the ambiance. The trays the servers served with to the scented candles in the bathrooms. Everything is well thought through and upscale looking. What impressed me even more was that the napkins were spotless white and ironed!
Only recommendation I have is to fix and clean the pillows in the sunroom. They are ripped and dirty. Design wise everything is extremely pleasant.
customer_insights: Suraya Restaurant in Philadelphia offers an exceptional dining experience with a focus on Middle Eastern cuisine, particularly mezze and seafood. The vibrant atmosphere, highlighted by an open kitchen and a lush garden, creates a unique setting ideal for various occasions, from romantic dinners to lively brunches.

googleReviews:
Went here for dinner with a few friends after a convention.  The host sat us right away even without a reservation which was fantastic for a Saturday.  The place is a bit narrow, but that is typical for the Philly area.

The food was really good, especially the pizza's.  Our server was friendly and was knowledgable about the menu offering up several suggestions to my friends.

I recommend if you're feeling pizza/american style type food.

Love this place! They welcomed us and seated us quickly. Our waitress Beth answered questions we had and then Took our orders. She told us it’s family style and things come out when they are ready and my husband and I were cool with that cause we planned to share everything. We ordered the house ground meatballs and they were so yummy and had Mozzarella cooked inside it so it was so moist and delicious. Then we ordered. The grilled calamari and we also got a porcini estrella mushroom pasta dish and for dessert we got a salted caramel budino which I will be dreaming of, it was so good. Highly recommend this place!!!

We popped in here for specifically the dessert, the Budino. It was excellent. Everyone should save room for dessert if they come here. We didn’t eat dinner here but we’ll be back for the pizza it looked delicious. Our server Aaron was super kind and chill and we enjoyed our mini date here.

Restaurant near Broad Street, very central location. As an Italian, I have to say it was very good, from the meat/fish to the pizza, with its soft and fluffy dough. The mozzarella wasn’t the best, but still a good pizza for the States.

The place isn’t very big inside, but it’s beautifully decorated with very modern finishes. In the evening, the dim lighting creates a very warm and friendly atmosphere. Service was super fast and the staff very friendly. Good mocktails. The dessert selection is quite limited, but the chocolate tiramisù was actually very good and worth trying!

Other than that, highly recommended!

I have walked past this establishment many times, tempted by the delicious scents wafting from the tables that adorn the sidewalk in the heart of Philadelphia.

A friend was in town for a visit and thought it was the perfect moment to give Barbuzzo a go.

The atmosphere was enchanting, nibbling on olives and gossiping with a friend as street goers rushed by.

I only rated it a 4star because the specialty cocktail was a flop.   At 15.00 (as much as a pizza) it was described as a spicy margarita and it fell short on all accounts.  It felt watered down with a flavor profile that was confusing to say the least.

The food however was scrumptious.   The pizza crust included just the right amount of char to feel like it came from your Nonna’s kitchen.

Although many would say they were just olives,  there was something delicious about the ones from Barbuzzo.  Firm, sweet, and meaty.

Although the drink was a flop I would definitely go back for another meal.
customer_insights: Barbuzzo is a trendy Italian eatery in Philadelphia known for its delicious pizzas and pasta dishes, served in a warm, inviting atmosphere. The restaurant is suitable for various occasions, from casual dinners to romantic dates, making it a versatile choice for locals and visitors alike.

googleReviews:
Upon entry of the restaurant we were greeted with a warm welcome and were offered a table immediately. The menu has practically any famous turkish dishes you can imagine. Upon looking over the menu we were handed appetizers and water to keep us occupied. The food came out almost 10 minutes after we placed our orders and everything was made just right. A peak over to the kitchen side and you can see the food being prepared fresh including the dough being braided for a separate dish. It’s refreshing to see a restaurant cooking and preparing from scratch. The quality, taste and mixture of flavors sit so well on the taste buds and the stomach once finished.

If I had to describe this place in a few words I’d have to say this is a hidden 5 star restaurant at not even less than a quarter of the costs.

The staff is super friendly and highly attentive, they give great recommendations and go in depth detail differentiating the dishes available.

This place is a home run.

Paprica Grill is absolutely outstanding! Their food is beyond delicious, truly mouthwatering, and easily the best Mediterranean cuisine in the entire tri-state area. Every dish is full of fresh flavors and perfectly prepared. It has become our go-to spot whenever we go out to eat as a family.

The service is excellent as well; the staff is warm, attentive, and always makes us feel welcome. If you’re looking for incredible food and a great dining experience, Paprica Grill never disappoints!

Paprica grill is great. The service amazing. Met the owner. He's very passionate for his restaurant. Cool vibes for family events or a nice dinner date. Try the mix platter. Lots of food, i couldn't eat the hole thing. Looking foward to lunching on my leftovers tomorrow. Very tasty.

The food was amazing, and the service was even better! They were very attentive! They even played peek-a-boo with my 1 year old who would normally not sit still in a high chair so I could enjoy my experience and finish my meal! Absolutely in love with the atmosphere, and the customer service experience. You can tell the food is prepared with care, and everything is halal! We definitely will be making frequent trips back to come visit. We’ve been to 5 star restaurants who can not even compare to this customer service and dining experience. 20/10 you can tell the owner actually cares about the guests who visit as he was also checking in on us and making sure we were enjoying our experience.

**5 star service**
It’s a small cozy place. It was very clean and comfortable. It was my first time in Philly and I had picked this place to meet up a friend. We had a great time. The staff were very attentive and friendly. They did not rush us so we had to get their attention if we wanted something but I didn’t mind it. I enjoyed not feeling like they were hovering till we ordered.

The food was great! It had a lot of flavor and they were big portions.
I ordered the chicken shish kebab, tabouli, Turkish tea. My friend ordered the hummus, lamb beyti, and Turkish tea.

Unfortunately I didn’t take any pics of the food as we were distracted catching up. The tea was very good. The cube is actually a sweet and not a sugar cube. I realized after I had put into the tea but it was still very good.
customer_insights: Paprica Grill is a cozy Mediterranean restaurant in Philadelphia known for its warm atmosphere and attentive service. Guests rave about the fresh, flavorful dishes and generous portions, making it a great spot for families, dates, and casual gatherings.

googleReviews: A laid back, casual BYOB middle eastern restaurant where everything was amazing!! All the items we ordered (even down to the pita bread) were so flavorful and delicious. The staff was also extremely kind, making the entire experience enjoyable. I will 100% be back!!

I love many middle eastern and mediterranean restaurants in philly, but alyans is what I have been looking for for years. I ordered the middle eastern platter, falafel platter, chicken shawarma sandwich, and fries and couldn't be happier with the quality and value of everything I ordered. The eggplant in the combo was heavenly, and the falafel was as good as I've ever had. The staff could not have been kinder or more generous. I can't wait to try more on the menu and with food of this quality and at these prices it won't be long before I do.

This place feels truly just like back home —the seating area gave me authentic Palestinian vibes. I ordered the falafel sandwich and it was honestly the best falafel I’ve had in Philly! The fries were also a nice different—not your usual restaurant , they came with fried onions mixed in, which added a really cool mix. Definitely a spot I’ll be coming back to

A hole-in-wall just off a busy block of South Street. Dined in on a Saturday night with a party of two and was seated immediately. Everything on the combo platter was flavorful, particularly the roasted eggplant, tabbouleh, and baba ghanoush. The chicken kebab sandwich was good, though a bit underseasoned. Great prices though, and very friendly service. Would recommend for a quick, casual meal. Popular for take out as well.

We came here hungry and were delighted by the platter we ordered - the Mediterranean combo. There’s a pretty sunroom in the back that we got to take advantage of. I’m also glad we ordered the baklava - it was so good, I ordered more to take home. I’ll be back next time I’m in town!
customer_insights: Alyan's Middle Eastern & Mediterranean Restaurant offers a casual dining experience with a focus on authentic flavors and friendly service. Customers rave about the quality of the food, particularly the falafel and various platters, making it a popular choice for both takeout and dine-in. The laid-back atmosphere and BYOB policy make it a great spot for casual gatherings or pregame meals.

googleReviews: Everything was amazing. The hummus, grape leaves, foul and lamb were all delicious.  The hot bread was so incredibly good. Really nice family style restaurant with a relaxed atmosphere. We were lucky to get a table. A lot of tables were reserved and it’s a cozy restaurant - so make a reservation if you can.

Highly recommend to go taste the middle eastern food and make a reservation before hand. Delicious and flavorful food and definitely going back. The staff was very friendly. There is a choice for everyone. Desserts are not too sweet.

Easy to find paid street parking.
We were introduced to this restaurant by a social media video of a couple eating in a traditional setting by eating on the floor/pillow area. Glad we didn’t do this bc there wasn’t a small table provided, so you either eat while you’re seated, hunched over your plate that is on floor level or you are holding your plate the entire time while eating. Did not look comfy at all.

We ordered hummus shawarma, sambosa, chicken kabsah , lamb fahsah, and Yemeni latte.
Hummus and sambosas were so yummy, pita was fresh and warm.
Chicken kabsah (rice and roasted chicken) was good. Our waiter recommended for us to get the spaghetti noodles on the side and we were glad we did.
Lamb fahsah (pieces of lamb, potatoes, and okra in a sizzling pot) was an interesting choice. A yummy, salty dish. Texture was a bit tricky bc of the okra but enjoyable while it was still hot. Good with the pita.
Coffee was good!
Customer service was good!

Lots of vegetarian options and exposed me to many unique Yemeni dishes. I ordered the falafel hummus and the fool and was satisfied—both came with warm bread which was quite nice. The chai tasted very authentic and was sweet which is how I like it.

The service was really great, our server was patient and gave us suggestions. The restaurant is cozy and while we sat at a table, I thought the floor seating was a great concept.

Had an amazing experience here . We ordered the lamb Haneeth & Chicken Mandi , along with the chicken hummus & lentil soup . And desert was Oum Ali . Everything was exceptionally fresh and delicious!
Liz , our waitress was super friendly and accommodating!
We would definitely go back !
customer_insights: Malooga offers a cozy and relaxed atmosphere with a focus on Middle Eastern cuisine, particularly Yemeni dishes. The restaurant is family-friendly and provides a unique dining experience, making it suitable for various occasions, including first dates and anniversaries.

googleReviews: These brothers are part of a long local family tradition of beloved restaurants, and this latest iteration continues and builds on that rich history with hearty flavors and portions that do not disappoint. This is where you bring friends visiting from out of town because the ambiance and service almost out does the food, it is so cozy and welcoming just to linger and talk. It's BYOB for now, but the rumor is they'll have house wine, beer, and drinks if all goes well. Come once and you will return again.

I had a lovely experience here. The food is outstanding. I had the lamb so tender. Everything I had was delicious the kebab and the dessert. The Turkish coffee and tea were amazing. I can’t say this enough times GO TO This Amazing restaurant. I promise you won’t regret it. I just LOVE IT!!!!

This place was absolutely incredible. The food was delicious, the best I’ve ever had. The service was amazing. The atmosphere was so so warm and inviting. The owner was so kind and attentive. He answered questions and checked back with us throughout the meal. This has become my new favorite place. I particularly adore Walid and would come back just for his service every time!!

Wow, one of the best dining experiences of my life.   A delicious meal in a magical setting eclipsed only by the warmth and hospitality of the owners Walid and MaryAnn.  We felt like guests in their home.   The prix fixe menu was incredible.  We loved the eggplant, the spicy Casablanca chicken (the standout of the evening), the lamb tajine, and of course the baklava, halvah and mint tea.  Highly highly recommended.

I didn't really like the food and I really wanted to, as I went for vegan restaurant week. The staff was super sweet and hospitable! My favorite thing was the lentil/cracked wheat dish--it was very good but I am sad it came out as the 3rd course. I wish they put the 3 courses together because I would've loved to mix and eat everything together. The pickled veggies became to sour to eat without anything else, the  hummus/baba ghanoush had such a great texture but I kept wanting a  deeper enhanced and acidic flavor to them. The falafel bhajiyas were very fried and had a nugget-like coating around it that made it seem like it wasn't really a falafel. The pita was super thin and dry and it just didn't hit. Sadly none of it hit for me. I love baklava and can eat it like its going out of style, however I felt the one here was a bit too sweet and syrupy for me--it was oozing out everywhere as I was eating it. And it was paired with sweetened tea. Overall, I was left with the feeling that I wish I got takeout somewhere else and not locked in to a prefixed menu/price.
customer_insights: Casablanca Mediterranean Grill offers a warm and inviting atmosphere with a strong emphasis on hospitality. While the food receives high praise for its flavors and quality, there are mixed reviews regarding specific dishes, particularly during special events like vegan restaurant week.

googleReviews: Went to Mona on a Saturday night. The only reservation I can get was 5 PM. First impressions when you walk into the restaurant is that it is beautiful. Well designed an excellent decor. We were seated immediately and waitress was at our table within a minute. We were first asked if we wanted anything to drink. We decided on Almaza a beer from Lebanon and peach of Poseidon. The beer was very good and an interesting flavor but the peach drink was not as good. Was supposed to be sweet but was not. As for appetizer we started with the “little of everything“ this gave you a taste of for different spreads of your choosing. I would recommend. Next we asked if there was a chef menu in which we could taste many different items. There is not. You can either go with a meal for each individual person or you can go with tapas ( small plates) we chose to go with small plates. We chose two different kebabs. One was the colossal shrimp and the other was the fillet both were very good. From the mezze menu I would definitely recommend the dumplings. The service was average to above average. Nothing to write home about had to wait for a while for a second drink. The food does come out quickly. It’s a ready kitchen. Overall I would give Mona four stars mainly for the atmosphere. The food is pretty good not the best I’ve had. Total price with tip for two people $150.

About a month ago, I tried Mona with some friends. None of us had been here before. The inside is gorgeous..definitely a venue made for events of all kinds, especially celebrations. The food is delicious and worth the price! We all enjoyed our entrees. I tried the chicken, another the mona fries, the sausage, the bronzeno, lamb chops and for the table the hummus sampler. The waitress was friendly and I really enjoyed the atmosphere. We got to see a few birthday celebrations and they go all in with the lights and celebration. If your looking for a unique and special venue you got to check out Mona!

My friends took me here for my birthday last week. The interior design is aesthetically pleasing, very chic and posh. Our server Peter was attentive and he recommended the best. The food and drinks were amazing. Would highly recommend!

Great atmosphere! Very upscale with good food and great drinks. Service was top tier (happy hour) and food tasted homemade. Really enjoyed experience, my only issue is the bathrooms are downstairs. I just wish bathrooms were more accesible to customers at the bar. Everything else is great.

I did not get the same treatment as the other guests. I’m going to give the service a 2 star solely from the my birthday experience. I booked a week in advance and mentioned my birthday. I witnessed 2 birthday celebration before mine and 1 after mine. Each birthday celebration turn the lights off for a dedication for the birthday person but mine was rushed and not the same experience. Food amazing but the overall bday experience was not the same across the boards. The positive it the food was great, ambiance was great, atmosphere was great, even the server was nice… it’s just the bday experience was not the same experience.
customer_insights: Mona offers a chic and upscale atmosphere perfect for celebrations and special occasions. While the food is generally well-received, service can vary, especially during busy times. The venue is ideal for both intimate gatherings and lively nights out.

address: 517 S Leithgow St, Philadelphia, PA 19147, USA
googleReviews:
Marrakesh is quite a unique experience - a must try at least one time!

My friends and I came to celebrate a birthday. It was tight quarters, so we were sitting back to back with the group next to us. Expect to be a little cramped, it’s just part of the experience.

They rinse your hands with warm water and then throw towels on your lap. Then immediately start the 7-course dinner ($40pp). I won’t go into every detail, but the standouts were the spicy chicken (truly the best chicken I’ve ever had), beef skewers and the egg dish. The lamb we were not a fan of and couscous dish was bland. The baklava my friends enjoyed, I found it a bit too sweet personally.

There was a belly dancing performance which was great entertainment. The staff were all SO friendly and welcoming. We truly felt like we were transported into Morocco.

I’m not sure if I would come back, only because while I did really enjoy some dishes, others fell a little flat for me. And I believe you can only ever do the whole tasting menu, not a la carte. I’m still glad I got to experience it!

Our party of four had an unforgettable experience at Marrakesh! From the moment we arrived, the evening felt special, you actually knock on the door to be welcomed inside, which immediately sets the tone for something unique. The décor is stunning, with an authentic and stylish design that transports you straight to Morocco.

The meal itself was a journey. They serve a series of dishes from appetizers all the way to dessert, and you can choose between lamb, beef, or vegetarian options; everything was flavorful and beautifully presented. The atmosphere is made even more vibrant with Arabic music playing in the background, and we were lucky to enjoy a talented belly dancer who brought so much energy and fun to the room.

To top it all off, the owner personally came around to greet every table with warm Middle Eastern hospitality. That thoughtful gesture was the cherry on top of an already amazing night. Highly recommend Marrakesh for anyone looking for a truly unique dining experience in Philly!

An unforgettable dining experience at Marrakesh!

From the moment we stepped inside, we knew we were in for something special. The ambiance immediately transported us, and the entire evening felt like a celebration of tradition, flavor, and hospitality.

The experience began with a warm and fragrant rose water hand washing ritual — such a charming and elegant touch. The multi-course feast that followed was nothing short of spectacular. Both the chicken and lamb were melt-in-your-mouth tender, falling off the bone effortlessly. The seasoning combinations were unique and exciting, especially the unexpected use of powdered sugar with chicken — something we had never tried before, but surprisingly delicious and well-balanced.

The service was friendly and efficient, and the pacing of the meal allowed us to savor each dish. The evening was perfectly rounded off with mint tea and sweet baklava — a refreshing and satisfying end.

Adding to the festive vibe, the belly dancer was incredibly talented and engaging, bringing even more energy to the room without overwhelming the dining experience.

If you’re looking for a fun, immersive, and delicious evening in Philly, Marrakesh should be at the top of your list. We’re already planning our return visit!

This was my second time here and I can’t wait to come back again! This family run place has been around for over 30years serving not just amazing food, but atmosphere as well. They have three stories of seating, although I would recommend getting a reservation because they are always busy. It is a set meal, 7 course experience with food reflecting what I had when I traveled to Morocco! Best to bring a group of at least 4 to enjoy the family style eating. It is also byob and they encourage good vibes and dancing! Cannot recommend this place enough!

Highly recommend making a reservation.
When you arrive, you ring the doorbell to be let in the restaurant. From the start, the atmosphere is so immersive. You sit on low cushioned benches around a huge gold tray perched on a stand. Pillows cover the seats.
First, they pour warn rose water over your hands in preparation for eating. As it's a Moroccan Restaurant, and the food is served communally, you're encouraged to eat with your hands. They do provide silverware if you wish.
The server does a great job of asking after any allergies or dietary needs before starting. Then they ask you if you want lamb or beef kababs (we got the lamb, next time we'll try the beef), and you get a choice between 2 types of chicken. After that, it's a parade of food. (They say 7 courses, but the 2 desserts are served in one course) I've pictured all of our courses... we may have eaten some before taking a couple of pictures 😆.
The servers offered to take a group picture and were very on top of filling drinks and making sure we had enough food.

In a previous visit, there had been a belly dancer, but we didn't see one this visit. Also, the website listed here on Google appears to be AI generated and doesn't have accurate information, so call with any questions.
customer_insights: Marrakesh offers a unique and immersive dining experience with a multi-course Moroccan feast served in a vibrant atmosphere, complete with live entertainment. Guests appreciate the warm hospitality and authentic decor, making it ideal for celebrations and group gatherings.

address: 1401 E Susquehanna Ave, Philadelphia, PA 19125, USA
googleReviews: This was a really special brunch experience and the food was exceptional. The parfait was perfect - sour, creamy homemade yogurt, mint, and sweet crunch granola. It was spicy, sweet, creamy. The Corsican breakfast was great and very different. Finally, the pancakes were great - the cinnamon was powerful, fresh. This was a great meal and I will make an excuse to come again!

Cute restaurant by the pool with a charming atmosphere and great food. We went there for brunch and enjoyed it a lot. The omelette was especially delicious. And they have a nice list of nonalcoholic cocktails. The service was excellent I have to say and made our afternoon very enjoyable. I’d definitely come back to try more of their food and soak up the sun.

I think this is one of the best hidden gems in Philly! I’ve been twice now and have never been disappointed. The cocktails are incredible, and the swordfish brochettes with pesto and black rice…one of the best things I’ve ever eaten. Their fresh pastas are incredible and perfect for sharing as an app. Dare I say their version of an espresso martini is the best I’ve had? I love that it’s not vodka based. We have sat at the bar both times & have had lovely conversations with the bartenders, who are very friendly and knowledgeable. I’ve never felt rushed and the overall vibe is elevated while comfortable. This is a spot I will keep coming back to!

This new American spot inside a boutique hotel in Fishtown has a great ambiance, so nice inside! We came to celebrate my friend’s birthday, and the staff were attentive, even giving us a complimentary starter and ice cream dessert. The seasonal menu is full of creative dishes, and we tried almost everything! My favorites were the grilled octopus and the T-bone dry-aged ribeye with frites, the mushrooms were great. The only downside is the menus, they hand each of us about five sheets for drinks, food, specials, and bottles, which felt a bit much. Portions are a bit small for the price, but overall the food is good and worth trying.

Really loved the cocktails, also appreciated that they had definitions for us non-experts. We had a skate cheeks swordfish, and the special pasta dish, which were all very good. For dessert we had the olive oil cake, especially mixed with a berry was absolutely delicious. Service was very good. It does get a bit loud, very lively atmosphere.
customer_insights: Bastia is a trendy upscale dining venue in Fishtown, known for its creative seasonal menu and exceptional cocktails. The atmosphere is lively yet comfortable, making it suitable for various occasions, from brunch to romantic dinners.

googleReviews:
We started with the hummus sampler, served with warm pita — flavorful and delicious. I had the lamb neck for my entrée; it was tender and tasty. The fennel side had a unique, slightly acquired flavor — not my favorite but not bad either.
My friend’s za’atar chicken looked and tasted great. Service was friendly and attentive, and overall it was a very good dining experience.

i have been to laserwolf in bk and had an amazing meal so was so excited when i found this was also from the same chef. the food was delicious and comforting. if we had an endless stomach, we would have ordered the whole menu. menu highlights: hummus tehina (try it with the fries and its the perfect bite), fries (obvi), lamb kofte (cooked perfectly and juicy), and coconut malabi (loved it).

We were visiting from out of town and made a reservation at Dizengoff to celebrate a special day together. From the moment we walked in we felt taken care of. David made sure we had a great table, and Valentina was wonderful. This was the best hummus we’ve ever had. French fries had the perfect crunchiness. Entrees were very plentiful. Highly recommend this restaurant!

Hummus: 5/5 A+. BEST humus I EVER HAD. I normally don’t like humus. This was AMAZING.

Lamb Kofte: 2/5. The other stuff on the plate was good. The lamb was…not good. Felt like my entire insides smelt like lamb for the next few hours. Still makes me sick thinking about it.

Chicken schnitzel: 4/5. Pretty good. Specially if you put some of the humus on it. Could use a little more…seasoning or salt but it was my first time with Israeli food. It could be a cultural thing.

Frozen pink lemonade: 4/5. Thank god I ordered this. Was a really good pallet cleanse after that lamb dish. Wish they made the drink minty by actually crushing the mint into the drink and not just throwing it on top, but solid drink overall.

Chocolate pita French toast: 3.5/5. A little too sweet. Felt like I was eating a cake but I took the leftovers home and have been enjoying taking bits of it here and there since yesterday.

Service: the server came by ONCE like 5 minutes after we got our food and never again. I had to wave her down a few times to order additional things (I ordered the French toast and wanted something savory after a few bites). I mean I was sitting there the entire time that my gf was eating just waiting for the server to come by our area.

Overall, In the future, I’ll def order the hummus to go, but won’t be eating the other things

Lovely food. Hummus spread variety was pretty unique with some really bold flavors. Pita of course was the soft, warm, and chewy. For mains, the chicken thighs was garlicky, juicy, bright, and flavorful. Chicken a chnitzel was crispy and moist. Everything was fairly basic but didn’t try to be anything over the top. A bit pricey but a porthole experience to come back for.
customer_insights: Dizengoff is celebrated for its exceptional hummus and warm pita, making it a go-to spot for Mediterranean comfort food. The atmosphere is friendly and casual, making it suitable for various occasions, from first dates to group outings.

address: 161 W Girard Ave, Philadelphia, PA 19122, USA
googleReviews:
Great meal overall — some of the best Mediterranean flavors I’ve had. The first courses were incredible (especially the Lamb Kibbeh and Lamb Carpaccio), but the middle courses fell flat with sauces that were way too strong. Strip loin was super tender but had a lot of tendon, and the trout was just okay (clams were the best part).

Cocktails were mixed: In-Cider Information was excellent, but the lemon meringue and sass-squash drinks were pretty bad. Service was solid and we appreciated the complimentary caviar for a birthday. Nice bonus that they take InKind, so we saved $100.

Good restaurant with some standout dishes — just not perfectly consistent.

This place definitely deserves all the praise. Everything was phenomenal. The atmosphere was warm, cozy and inviting. The staff was exceptional- both attentive and genuinely friendly. Shoutout to Erin for all her amazing recommendations and Lucky who brought out every dish with a friendly smile. The tasting menu offered one-of-a-kind dishes and creative drinks that made the experience truly memorable. We will be visiting again in the future!

One of the best food experiences I've had in years! Plenty of food options around the City, personally, I live and eat in the burbs and haven't been to the City in years...this was not only worth it, but a place I'm already planning to come back to! Get the chef's Tasting Menu, trust me, you will leave full and experience a culinary tour of gastro perfection! There wasn't a bite that didn't wow me, and I took pictures of this season's chef menu items that we enjoyed. Can't wait to experience the next season's creations. Whatever you imagine this tastes like, 10X it more! Trust me, don't walk, RUN and make a res...or 2.

Mind-blowing.
The flavor, texture, technique, and attention to detail were absolutely incredible. Each dish offered layers of complexity, with so many components working together seamlessly. Every bite delivered a new burst of flavor that made you pause and appreciate how everything just makes sense on the palate.

It was truly a memorable dining experience.
Our server was amazing—she was incredibly knowledgeable about the menu and made the experience even better. The chefs were friendly and clearly passionate about their craft.

I'm still reeling from our incredible experience here! I'd read all the reviews beforehand, but nothing could've prepared me for just how amazing it would be. The food was literally out of this world - every bite was a flavor explosion. But what really made our night special was the service. Marissa was so warm and welcoming, making us feel right at home. And then there was Erin, who totally went above and beyond to make our date night nothing short of spectacular. From the minute we walked in to the moment we left, everything was just perfect. I'm so glad we chose to come here - it's definitely a night to remember!
customer_insights: Emmett in Philadelphia offers a memorable Mediterranean dining experience with standout dishes and exceptional service. While some dishes may lack consistency, the overall atmosphere is warm and inviting, making it suitable for various occasions including dates and celebrations.

googleReviews:
From Los Angeles, in Philly for work all week, I hadn’t left my hotel until Friday night when my wife and I decided to treat ourselves to a special dinner before flying home. We searched high and low online for the perfect spot and came across OLEA—the photos looked beautiful and inviting, and it turned out to be even more magical in person.

From the moment we arrived, we were greeted by the owner, Louie, whose warmth and charm set the tone for the evening. The restaurant itself is cozy, elegant, and homey all at once—like stepping into someone’s welcoming living room but with the refinement of a thoughtfully curated dining space.

I ordered the salmon with leek and mushroom purée, while my wife had the swordfish, both accompanied by perfectly creamy mashed potatoes. Every bite was outstanding—beautifully balanced flavors, fresh ingredients, and executed with care.

What made the night truly unforgettable, though, was Louie himself. He personally waited on us, bringing so much humor, kindness, and hospitality that we felt like cherished guests in his own home. At one point, I watched him water the window box plants above the restaurant’s hand-painted picture window, a simple but telling gesture of the love and detail he pours into his place.

OLEA is BYOB, and when we mentioned we hadn’t brought wine, Louie suggested we pop next door. Instead, he surprised us by getting a chilled sparkling bottle for $12—absolutely delicious and the perfect pairing.

The entire experience felt personal, warm, and special—the kind of dinner you remember long after. OLEA is truly a diamond in the rough in Philly, the best find of our trip, and we can’t recommend it highly enough. We will definitely be back next time we’re in Philadelphia—and I’ll be telling everyone I know that OLEA is the place to dine.

Man oh man, what a spot. Typically I’m not huge on Italian food, but this place took it to another level. So many good flavor choices and pairings. I couldn’t tell you what we ordered because someone ordered for us, but everything was delicious. Tried a bunch of the pastas and every one was off the charts.

Really liked the pork chop, perfectly cooked and juicy. Also, even though its is not a steakhouse, the steak came out better than most steakhouses.

As always. Sucker for dessert. The apple pie (sorry have no clue what it’s actually called) and the pistachio tiramisu were both incredible.

P.s. staff was very friendly and accommodating. They really know their craft.
Olea was a warm inviting place to eat.  The food was amazing.  The octopus was arguably the best we’ve ever tasted.  It is cash only and BYOB.  We would recommend Olea if you are in Philly.

We had a wonderful time here! Cozy, dimly lit with candles, and good music. Started with complimentary hummus and pita, then ordered the rest of our meal. We had the octopus, truffle lobster rigatoni, and 14oz NY strip steak. Everything tasted amazing, with our highlights being the octopus and pasta (they even split our pasta so that we could share easier!). We ended the meal with pistachio tiramisu with a nice amaretto flavor. Thanks for a great meal Luis and team, we’ll be back!

- Claire and Ian

just amazing!! this may be my boyfriend and I’s new favorite spot in philly. we didn’t realize it was byob but we were quickly told to grab a bottle next door and they even switched it out for a cold one for us! the service was amazing and the rigatoni and swordfish were fantastic. definitely coming back and have already told all my friends about this spot!!
customer_insights: Olea is a cozy, upscale Italian restaurant known for its warm hospitality and exceptional food. Guests rave about the octopus, pasta dishes, and the personal touch from the owner, Louie, making it a perfect spot for romantic dinners and special occasions.
