googleReviews: We've been looking forward to trying Little Water for a while, especially since we've been to River Twice (the owner's other establishment) many times. Visiting Philly for our Thanksgiving 2025 trip was a great chance to finally experience this new restaurant. Overall, we had a very pleasant dinner but came away not especially blown away. Most of the dishes I felt I've had before, but better elsewhere. The swordfish milanese for example - I've had that other seafood restaurants but with more exciting sides, interesting presentation, or fried to a better crunch. The shrimp cocktail, while visually impressive, ended up being eating several huge shrimp that all tasted more bland than engaging. This was the trend for our dishes. Drinks were solid but dessert even was similarly something we've had elsewhere but more impressively done (a pumpkin financier.) Good restaurant and I'm happy it exists, but I'm hoping the menu gets a shake up.

From the moment we walked into Little Water, we felt completely welcomed. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, the staff could not have been more gracious, and every single dish reflected skill, care, and talent. It was one of those meals where you could feel Chef’s passion and creativity in every bite.

We started with the grand plateau, which was this massive seafood amalgamation that immediately set the tone for the evening. It was indulgent, abundant, and beautifully presented. Everything on it was excellent, but two things stole the show for me: the snow crab claws and the tuna nduja. The crab was lovely in its simplicity, sweet and delicate, and paired perfectly with the mustard that accompanied it. The tuna nduja, on the other hand, was bold and unforgettable. It had such an incredible depth of flavor that I will be thinking about it for the rest of my days.

The hush puppies with ricotta, lemon oil, and caviar were another standout. They were so decadent, yet playful at the same time. Cutting the hush puppies in half, smearing the ricotta, and then topping it with caviar was the kind of luxurious bite you dream about. The balance of richness, texture, and flavor was perfection.

The raw bluefin tuna was a dish that really shined in its simplicity and restraint. The portion was generous, the texture melt-in-your-mouth perfect, and the flavors so delicate that everything worked in harmony without overpowering the tuna itself. It was thoughtful and elegant, and it showed just how well this kitchen understands balance.

The Caesar-style salad was a pleasant surprise and far from an afterthought. It came out in a massive portion, generously blanketed in delicate locally-sourced cheese shavings that gave it such an indulgent feel. Crisp, refreshing, and full of flavor, it was easily one of the best salads I have had.

By this point we were already full, but when the Maine mussel toast arrived, all bets were off. The mussels were massive and beautifully flavored, and the toast beneath had the most satisfying crunch on the outside with a warm, savory interior that soaked up the flavors perfectly. It was rustic, comforting, and refined all at once.

Even though we could barely move by this point, dessert was impossible to resist. The key lime tart was the perfect finale: the crust was buttery and crisp, the filling tart and refreshing, and the topping of marshmallow-like meringue was fluffy, light, and just sweet enough. It tied everything together and sent us out the door on a high note.

The cocktails deserve their own spotlight. The penicillin milk punch was smooth and balanced, the mezcal cocktail I requested was smoky and beautifully crafted, and the glass of cremant with the seafood could not have paired more perfectly. It was clear that the same level of attention and artistry that goes into the food extends to the bar program.

What really brought the whole experience together was the hospitality. We were consistently checked on without ever feeling rushed, and it was clear the team takes real pride in ensuring every guest is cared for. Their attention to detail, from sourcing the best ingredients to plating generous portions with perfect execution, made every moment special.

Having loved River Twice, we already knew how gifted Chef and the team are, but Little Water is a brilliant complement, leaning more into seafood while still delivering the same passion and artistry. Both restaurants are absolute must-visits, and together they show just how exciting and memorable dining can be when done this well.

This was one of those meals I will never forget. Every dish was a star, the cocktails elevated the experience, and the hospitality made us feel at home. Five stars, without question.

Came here for my birthday 3 weeks ago. Experience was very average and disappointed especially at the price you pay. We came for dinner on a Wednesday- was decently busy.
We got grits, hash brown, octopus and 1 other app that I forget and the NY strip to share for the main. Flavor diversity was lacking and honestly just underwhelming. To be fair- we were really excited and had high expectations. Service was okay! very okay. Got the key lime tart to go and that okay as well. Overall- left upset that we chose that spot for my bday.
Great place for good food. The raw bar is great and the fish and duck were amazing! The key lime pie and the pumpkin dessert were amazing. Custom cocktail were also a hit! I would recommend going!
customer_insights: Little Water offers a warm and inviting atmosphere with a focus on seafood, showcasing both creativity and skill in its dishes. While some guests have found certain dishes underwhelming compared to expectations, many rave about the quality and presentation of the food, as well as the attentive service.

address: 1936 S Christopher Columbus Blvd, Philadelphia, PA 19148, USA
googleReviews:
Jenny was a great waitress. Very attentive, and on top of all of the needs of the table.
The hook and reel seasoning was good, but was missing something. I cant quite put my finger on it. The crab bites we ordered as an appetizer were good. The sauce was good.
Jenny was amazing.  Very patient with my dad who is very picky. It’s was his birthday and Jenny offered  him a cheesecake. That made his day. He loves cheesecake
I had one of the best waiters his name is Marquise. The food not so good but his service was amazing!! I definitely enjoyed the atmosphere there just not so much of the food.

When I visited late at night, the staff clearly showed their displeasure, which made the experience uncomfortable.

On top of that, gratuity was already included in the bill, but they failed to inform us properly, so we ended up tipping twice.

This was one of the worst service experiences I’ve had — I have no intention of returning.

This was my first time dining at Hook & Reel, and I must say I was very impressed! We came on a Saturday evening and were seated immediately, which was a pleasant surprise. Our waiter, Marquise, was absolutely amazing to say the least. He was extremely attentive, paid close attention to detail, and made sure everything was perfect from start to finish.
I ordered the Dungeness boil, and the food came out quickly and was delicious. I also tried the Watermelontini, which was the perfect touch to my meal.

Overall, my experience was a 10/10. We will definitely be returning! If you’re looking for great food and even better service, ask for Marquise  you’ll be in great hands.
customer_insights: Hook & Reel Cajun Seafood & Bar offers a lively atmosphere with a focus on seafood boils and Cajun flavors. While the service is often praised, the food quality can be inconsistent, with some diners reporting excellent experiences and others expressing disappointment. It's a suitable spot for casual gatherings, especially for groups looking to enjoy a fun night out.

googleReviews:
Great Group of people to be around and spend time with. Food is great! The atmosphere is amazing.  Very friendly people. I took a group of people from here to the Phillies game! Always a wonderful time with Fran and his very friendly crowd. I love this place and the people!
Thanks from Anthony with Academy Bus!

First time here & Last time trying!!
My crab cake was Soggy BROWN LETTUCE
Fries were old and over seasoned
No utensils for the Cole slaw and it smelled very bad , No napkins & bad customers
There’s 4 girls up front Lollygagging and on their phones not Prioritizing paying GUEST
$21 for that smh

This was a fabulous place. We definitely need to get back to try other menu items. Seafood menu on one side and burger menu on the other. Our server Astasia certainly was attentive to detail and a great conversationalist while being focused on each task, a wonderful young lady.
We started with appetizers' fried pickles, onion rings, mussels, and my choice of a bowl of shrimp and crab bisque from Harv's menu.
My wife Melanie started the night with a cheesecake martini and surprisingly ordered another midway through the visit. Her meal was a shrimp sampler (stuffed, scampi, and fried). My meal was broiled scallops with two sides. I definitely want to get back to try other things!
Gallo's is one of my favorite restaurants in Philly. The food is always fresh. The last recent visit I ordered their Mixed Green Salad. It hits the spot on a hot day.

I come to Gallo's every couple months, and the food is always yummy! Service is usually great (occasionally they are slow, but due to them being busy). I never had a bad meal. The mixed greens salad was amazing, with blue cheese, walnuts, cucumbers and cherry tomatoes, tossed in vinaigrette. Clans casino also yummy! Main course are always fresh as well!
customer_insights: Gallo's Seafood is a casual dining venue in Philadelphia known for its friendly atmosphere and seafood offerings. While many patrons enjoy the fresh food and lively environment, there are mixed reviews regarding service and food quality, particularly during busy times.

googleReviews: We had an amazing time at Chickie’s & Pete’s celebrating our friend’s birthday! 🎉 The atmosphere was upbeat and fun, the staff was friendly and on point, and the food  especially the crabfries and seafood  was absolutely fantastic. Everyone went out of their way to make it a special night, and we couldn’t have asked for better service or a better place to celebrate. Highly recommend for any occasion, great food, great drinks, great energy!

Good evening Google family. My very first time visiting this location of Chickie and Pete's. I have patronized the location in Drexel Hill, PA.  This location of Roosevelt Blvd is huge!!! I was seated when I arrived, my reservation was 3:15 pm. which I booked on the Open Table app. I took a Lyft there and I took a Lyft home. Didn't wish to deal with the parking there and in my block. I would not have had a parking spot in my block when I arrived back home. I was given a table and then they switched me to another table for one, since I was by myself. Being in a sports bar and watching the Eagles game is a true experience! It is nothing quite like it. You have to be there. They sing the Eagles fight song every time we score, it is truly a classic moment and I enjoyed every moment of it. I cannot wait to go back next week for the next game against the LA Rams. But I will not be coming back to this location. I wanted to go to the South Philly location but its so hard to book, its already booked up for the LA Rams game. Chickie and Pete's makes a killing!!! Shannen was our server and she was so kind, nice and patient. I know that I drove her crazy!!! She was too polite to say so. I gave her a good tip.  I ordered vegetable soup, a salad with the salmon and a seafood boil and a lemonade. Everything was good but if the boil did not have the red sauce on it, it would have been ideal!!! The red sauce made it hot!!! and I do not like hot or spicy food. I had ordered mussels and shrimp. So good but it was too hot because of the red sauce. I wanted to send it back but it was too late. Never again will I order that!!! I did not finish eating my order and I did not wish to take it home.  Also I was seated outside and when there is food on the table, here comes the horrible flies, it is a nightmare!!! I got so tired of shooing flies away!! I asked Shannen to take my plates because I grew so tired of the flies!!! The rest rooms were clean. I could not understand why they didn't have more restrooms. As big as that place is, they should have had two separate restrooms for women and men. There are four stalls in the women's rest room. The Eagles won and beat the Kansas City Chiefs, thank Goodness!!! They are winless so far, ha ha Patrick Mahomes!!! I had a great Eagles experience and I look forward to going to another location next week to watch the LA Rams game. Good night, workout, be healthy, fit and Fabulous!!!! My tab was $79.98.

Reserved a table and it was ready when we got there.  For appetizers, we went with of course crab fries and fried mozzarella. I went with the shrimp tacos and the place is also kid friendly with chicken tenders and pizza.  Our server was great and went the extra mile and I would recommend going here to others.

The last time we came to visit Chickie's and Pete's at this location was for the Eagles Super Bowl game back in February of this year. It was so nice to be back here with my son, who was also with me last time. It was an amazing experience. Even though this visit was during a regular work week on a Monday, I wasn't sure what to expect in terms of the crowd. So, I made a reservation online through OpenTable, which was very easy to do. When I arrived, my table was all set and ready for us. The atmosphere for the evening felt really good.

I absolutely love Chickie's and Pete's. Even though they don't have a vegan menu, they do have a few options that can be modified to be vegan. This time, I ordered the shrimp tacos but with impossible meat instead of shrimp and without the dressing. They were absolutely delicious. We also ordered a side of sweet potato fries with hot honey. They were excellent, but they reduced the portion slightly due to costs. So, we ended up ordering another order of fries. My son and I are both big guys, so one portion wasn't enough. So, we also ordered crab fries because you can never go wrong with Chickie's and Pete's crab fries.

My son ordered a chicken Parm sandwich with sharp provolone on an Italian roll and he said it was delicious. Our server was very friendly and I even had the pleasure of meeting Erin, the manager. She was absolutely wonderful and was there every step of the way to assist with anything we needed. She is a kind and caring person - a great manager who makes you feel like family. She should be a role model for other managers.

I was a bit surprised that many people left after halftime, resulting in a smaller crowd. But I understand it was a Monday night during a work week and it was a late game. The weekends are always packed at Chickie's and Pete's, so I totally get it. People have to work and get up early. Despite that, I absolutely love it here and can't wait to come back again soon.
Music a little too loud. However awesome service and fresh food🥰. Will def visit again.
customer_insights: Chickie's & Pete's offers a vibrant atmosphere, especially during sports events, making it a popular choice for celebrations and gatherings. While the food, particularly the crab fries, receives high praise, some guests have noted issues with seating and service during peak times.

googleReviews: I recently ordered the sautéed crab in their special sauce for $18 per pound. When I placed my order, I inquired about the size and condition of the crab, and the server mentioned it would be a variety of sizes. Unfortunately, the quality was disappointing. Two out of the four crabs had only one claw each, and one had just a single small leg. The rest were in poor condition and heavily coated in the sauce. The sauce itself was excessively salty, and even after rinsing off the excess, it remained too salty to eat. Ultimately, I had to discard them. The crabs were in the worst condition and inedible due to the saltiness.

I’m happy that I did not spend any more money than I already did. Unfortunately, I’ didn’t find My food to be good. When I’m ordering shrimp from a seafood place, I don’t want fake shrimp, I want fresh shrimp, Especially with the prices that they’re charging, As well as their fish.. For the prices that they are charging, it shouldn’t be Fillet. We should be getting the whole fish. That has been my experiences at other establishments. The only thing that I enjoyed was the soda that came with my food. Will never come here again. Very, very  disappointed don’t waste your time or money.

No good at all nothing has seasoning, you get more sides than seafood. The most unpleasant seafood experience I’ve had in a while got about 7 muscles every one was gritty 3 weren’t edible
Who the hell puts carrots in a seafood platter anything to sell more side than seafood very disgusting should have just gotten a fried platter because the steamed 1s suck

A very popular spot in this area, often with a line inside. There are no tables, only takeout. The food is prepared quickly, within 15 minutes. They also offer a lot of ready-made items like crabs. If you want to cook at home, they have marinated chicken, shrimp, and more. We bought different assorted ready meals here a couple of times, and they included free sauces, pasta salad, and soda, which was a nice touch. However, there's a downside — we stopped buying food here a long time ago because even from outside, the smell of overused frying oil is overwhelming. It’s more of a stench than a smell at this point. I don’t think such food can be healthy or safe anymore.
I paid $32 for this bs… never again!!
customer_insights: Alaska King Crab House has received numerous negative reviews regarding the quality of their seafood, particularly the crab and shrimp offerings. Customers have expressed disappointment in the preparation and seasoning, with many stating that the food was inedible or poorly cooked. The venue primarily serves takeout, making it more suitable for casual dining rather than a special occasion.

googleReviews: LOVE !! Having Fishtown Seafood so close to us, Bryan is extremely helpful and knowledgeable as is his crew. The wife and I enjoy seeing the oyster selections broken down and rated as to how large, small, salty, plump, or sweet they are. Bryan showed us first hand at the front counter how to shuck an oyster, so we purchased a knife along with two dozen of the best oyster we have had in a while. We have been back several times and even purchased several dozen to bring to our friends in Richmond VA. Go visit and help support this hidden gem in Haddonfield.

Amazing quality and super knowledgeable. I absolutely love their selection for a fork dropping good dinner. Any reservations you may have about making a dish will be squashed with the care and guidance these fine folks can provide. We’re going to do an Oyster Shucking class! What a cool concept?!? Simply put, Fishtown Seafood is my go to when I’m in town!

Got some seafood filling and shrimp… wow !! The lovely dude at the front counter gave us some good tips and we enjoyed some homemade seafood ravioli with vodka sauce and shrimp! Would definitely recommend checking out this cute little corner fish spot.

We’ve been so happy to know that Fishtown Seafood is around the corner. Bryan  is highly knowledgeable and passionate about what he sells and makes great recommendations every time! We enjoy the Friday happy hour oyster selections, and recently tried the sashimi grade salmon which was delicious! We used the salmon to make a ceviche.
It’s so great to have a small business in the neighborhood that offers fresh and responsibly sourced seafood. It’s become our go-to spot!

Fishtown Seafood has an amazing variety of fish and seafood options. The quality is amazing and you can really taste the difference. Bryan is highly knowledgeable and directly sources the seafood. The fish packaging even reveals the captain of the boat’s name; it’s clear to see that everyone involved with getting the seafood to your door is proud of the product they sell.
happy_hour_details: Friday happy hour with oyster selections
customer_insights: Fishtown Seafood is a beloved local seafood market known for its high-quality offerings and knowledgeable staff. Customers appreciate the hands-on experience, including oyster shucking classes and personalized recommendations, making it a great spot for casual dining and social gatherings.
